trait.name: Harvest Dance
entries: The Pumpkin King is surrounded by gourds and vegetables churning in the ground and floating in the air. The area within 15 feet of the Pumpkin King is difficult terrain that doesn’t impede the Pumpkin King’s movement. At the start of each of the Pumpkin King’s turns, each creature in this area takes 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage. The Pumpkin King decides whether this effect is active at the start of their turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Pumpkin King fails a save, they can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Pumpkin King has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Pumpkin King makes four Vine or Blight Bolt attacks. P P 246 Vine. Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) if it is a Large or smaller creature.

action.name: Blight Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) necrotic damage. If the target is a Plant, it takes an extra 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Pumpkin King moves up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Fire-Fallow (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Magical fire ignites from within the Pumpkin King’s pumpkin head, flickering out from their eyes and twisted mouth. Each creature within 10 feet of the Pumpkin King that can see them must succeed on a DC 16 WIS save or take 5 (2d4) fire damage and be frightened until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Grasping Roots (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature on the ground and grappled by the Pumpkin King must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or be restrained in place by roots, ending the grapple. A creature, including the target, can take its action to free the restrained creature by succeeding on a DC 16 STR check.

monster.name: Pyroclasm
senses: keensense 60 ft. (can’t sense beyond this radius)

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The pyroclasm can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Molten Form
entries: A creature that touches the pyroclasm or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 2 (1d4) fire damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of wood becomes scorched. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of wood that hits the pyroclasm is destroyed after dealing damage. The pyroclasm can burn through a panel of nonmagical wood in its space that is up to 2 inches thick in 1 round.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The pyroclasm doesn’t require sleep.

trait.name: Ooze Resilience
entries: The pyroclasm is resistant to the grappled and restrained conditions, and it is immune to exhaustion and to the blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, and prone conditions.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The pyroclasm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) fire damage, and the creature is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Large or smaller creature. A creature grappled by the pyroclasm takes 2 (1d4) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Lob Fiery Goo
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) fire damage, and the target takes an extra 2 (1d4) fire damage at the start of its next turn as the sticky goo continues to burn it.

reaction.name: Shifting Stone
entries: When a creature the pyroclasm can see attacks it with a weapon, the pyroclasm can shift the molten rocks in its body to absorb some of the blow, reducing the damage by 7 (2d6). 247 P P

trait.name: Fey Resilience
entries: The quimbus is resistant to the charmed and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: Hallucinogenic Oil
entries: The quimbus secretes an oil that causes hallucinations. A creature that isn’t a Fey and that touches the quimbus or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 WIS save or suffer hallucinations for 1 minute. A creature suffering hallucinations can’t tell friend from foe, is neutral toward each creature around it unless attacked (then it becomes hostile to that creature), and can’t benefit from effects like the Help action or the bless spell. When the hallucinating creature moves, it moves in a random direction, and when it attacks, it attacks a random creature within the attack’s range. The hallucinating creature doesn’t perceive reality as it is and might see nearby creatures as terrain features, such as rocks or trees, or vice versa. The hallucinating creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The quimbus’s long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quimbus makes two Bite attacks or three Spit Poison attacks. If two attacks hit one creature, the target is subjected to the quimbus’s Hallucinogenic Oil trait.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

action.name: Spit Poison
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (5d6 + 2) poison damage.

bonus.name: Reeling Tongue
entries: The quimbus lashes out its tongue at one

bonus.name: Medium or smaller creature it can see within 15 feet of it
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or be pulled up to 10 feet closer to the quimbus.

reaction.name: Splash Oil
entries: When the quimbus takes damage that isn’t necrotic, psychic, or radiant, it can use the force of the blow to spread its oil. Each creature within 10 feet of the quimbus is subjected to the quimbus’s Hallucinogenic Oil trait.

trait.name: Celestial Resilience
entries: The raiju is resistant to radiant damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The raiju has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Storm Weapons
entries: The raiju’s weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d4 lightning damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Storm Mantle
entries: A creature that touches the raiju or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 2 (1d4) lightning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The raiju makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or it makes three Lightning Bolt attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) lightning damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) lightning damage.

action.name: Lightning Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) lightning damage.

action.name: Thunderous Roar (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The raiju emits a booming roar in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 CON save. On a failure, a creature takes 22 (5d8) thunder damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from the raiju. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t pushed.

bonus.name: Lightning Leap (Recharge 4–6)
entries: The raiju briefly transforms into a ball of lightning and moves up to 30 feet in a straight line. It can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature along that line must succeed on a DC 15 DEX save or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn. 249 R R Rakshasa, Chaos-Touched There’s a wild power in the tiger-headed humanoid’s eyes, seemingly belied by the playfulness of its garish clothes.

bonus.name: Disrupted Reincarnation
entries: When a rakshasa is slain, its spirit lingers on the Material Plane until reincarnating through a corrupted mortal. Sometimes, however, something goes wrong—exposure to the Void, a powerfully incorruptible mortal, or similar forces—and the rakshasa’s spirit gets warped along the way. These new creatures tend to forsake complicated, manipulative scheming and are driven instead by instinct, whim, and their rapidly shifting emotions.

bonus.name: Chaotic Minds
entries: Chaos-touched rakshasas can inflict the turbulence in their minds upon others and frighten those who look upon them.

bonus.name: Unpredictable and Unsettling
entries: Chaos-touched rakshasas’ personalities can vary from day to day, and this mercurial nature is often reflected in their appearance— mismatched clothing, clashing colors—and through behavioral quirks, such as muttering to unseen figures or giggling uncontrollably. However, their more lucid moments are often the most frightening, especially to minions and cohorts. R R 250

trait.name: Monstrosity Resilience
entries: The rampede is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

trait.name: Wasteland Camouflage
entries: The rampede’s Stealth is 17 while in badlands or similar terrain with little vegetation.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rampede makes two Shovel Head attacks.

action.name: Shovel Head
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone.

action.name: Heedless Charge (Recharge 4–6)
entries: The rampede moves up to 20 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. The first time it enters a creature’s space during this move, that creature must make a DC 13 STR save. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (4d4) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t knocked prone. Until the end of its next turn, the rampede’s AC is 12, its immunity to the prone condition becomes resistance, and it has disadvantage on DEX checks and saves.

bonus.name: Skewer
entries: The rampede can impale a Medium or smaller prone creature within 5 feet of it with one of its legs. The target is restrained. If the target is Small or smaller, it moves with the rampede when the rampede moves, but the rampede’s speed is halved while impaling a Small creature. The rampede can’t move while impaling a Medium creature and must end the impale to move. A creature, including the target, can take its action to free the target by succeeding on a DC 13 STR check. The rampede can have only one Small or Medium creature impaled in this way at a time, but it can have any number of Tiny creatures impaled at a time.

reaction.name: Head Block
entries: The rampede can add 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it, swinging its armored head in the way of the blow. To do so, it must see the attacker. 251 R R

trait.name: Accustomed to Filth
entries: The rattus eel has advantage on saves against contracting diseases.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The rattus eel can’t use its keensense while deafened.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The rattus eel can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Heightened Hearing
entries: The rattus eel’s Perception is 15 while perceiving by hearing. R R 252

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

bonus.name: Scurry
entries: The rattus eel moves up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

reaction.name: Panic Regurgitation (Recharge 5–6)
entries: When the rattus eel takes damage, it can cough up an old meal. Each creature within 10 feet of the eel that can smell must succeed on a DC 10 CON save or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn. Rattus eels automatically succeed.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The razor drake doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The razor drake makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The razor drake spits virulent acid in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 DEX save, taking 35 (10d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature made of stone or crystal has disadvantage on the save.

bonus.name: Wing Slash
entries: The razor drake slices both wings across one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 15 STR save or suffer a bleeding wound. A creature with a bleeding wound loses 5 (2d4) HP at the start of each of its turns. Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 12 WIS (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing. Drake, Shoreline The ungainly creature seems to mix a seal’s body with an osprey’s head and talons as it holds itself aloft by constantly fluttering its seal-like flippers. Nearly imperceptible scales betray its draconic heritage.

bonus.name: Wide-Ranging Territories
entries: Shoreline drakes claim stretches of coastline as their protectorates. Though better equipped for sea travel than flight, they enjoy flying through their territories. When they dip down into the water, they must contest with sharks and other large aquatic predators. Though their territories often overlap, the drakes rarely attack one another and instead engage in a friendly rivalry, marked by showing off the spoils of their hunts.

bonus.name: Selkie Friends
entries: For as long as shoreline drakes and selkies can recall, the two have shared an unbreakable comradery. The drakes often leave their young with selkie communities for protection while repaying the kindness by serving as guardians for the selkies. Selkies also teach the young drakes to respect seals, and the drakes eschew preying upon the marine mammals.

bonus.name: Welcome Visitors
entries: The drakes often extend their friendship to humanoids—presuming a proper respect for the sea—and will swim or fly circles around marine predators and hazards to alert nearby sailors. Like most dragons, the drakes also collect treasures and stash them within hidden coves, and they happily trade with humanoids who have goodies to offer. Their most prized treasures are the teeth or beaks of massive underwater creatures, such as sharks and krakens.

monster.name: Riftspawn
languages: understands Deep Speech but can’t speak

trait.name: Aberrant Resilience
entries: The riftspawn is resistant to the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, and stunned conditions, and it has advantage on saves against spells or effects that would alter its form.

trait.name: Teleport Sense
entries: The riftspawn can pinpoint, by scent, the location of planar portals, teleportation circles, and creatures that have traveled through a portal or teleportation magic within the past hour within 120 feet of it, and it can sense the general direction of such magic and creatures within 1 mile of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The riftspawn makes one Bite attack and two Hooked Tentacle attacks, or it makes three Resin Spray attacks. If two Resin Spray attacks hit one creature, the target is restrained. A creature, including the target, can take its action to free the target by succeeding on a DC 16 STR check.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

action.name: Hooked Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Resin Spray
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage, and the resin coats the target for 1 minute. While coated, the target’s speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it can’t teleport or leave its current plane of existence. A creature, including the target, can take its action to scrape off the resin, ending the effect.

bonus.name: Persistent Hunter
entries: The riftspawn moves up to half its speed toward a hostile creature it can see. This movement is unaffected by difficult terrain.

reaction.name: Consume Residue
entries: When a creature the riftspawn can see within 30 feet of it casts a conjuration spell, the riftspawn can consume the magic of the spell, countering it. This works like the counterspell spell, except the riftspawn must always make a spellcasting ability check, no matter the spell’s circle. Its ability check for this is +6. If it successfully counters the spell, the riftspawn regains 5 HP for each circle of the spell. 253 R R

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the rimecaller moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 STR save or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Heightened Smell
entries: The rimecaller’s Perception is 20 when perceiving by smell.

trait.name: Monstrosity Resilience
entries: The rimecaller is resistant to exhaustion and the frightened condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rimecaller makes one Bite or Gore attack and two Claw attacks. If both Claw attacks hit one creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 17). The rimecaller can grapple only one creature at a time. R R 254 Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) cold damage, and the target must make a DC 15 CON save. On a failure, the creature begins to magically transform into ice and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the save at the end of its next turn, remaining restrained and becoming incapacitated on a failure, or ending the effect on itself on a success. The restrained and incapacitated creature must repeat the save at the end of its next turn, transforming into ice and becoming petrified on a failure, or ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that is transformed into ice remains petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) cold damage.

bonus.name: Frigid Stomp
entries: The rimecaller stomps its hooves, freezing the ground in a 10-foot radius around a point it can see within 5 feet of it. This ice slick lasts for 1 minute. A creature other than a rimecaller that enters the ice slick for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there, must make a DC 15 DEX save or fall prone.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The riptide ogre can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Breaching Leap
entries: If the riptide ogre is at least half-submerged in water, its long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Giant Attributes
entries: The riptide ogre is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.

trait.name: Speak with Water Beasts
entries: The riptide ogre can communicate with Beasts with a swimming speed as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The riptide ogre makes one Anchor attack and two Greatclub attacks, or it makes three Javelin attacks.

action.name: Anchor
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 20 feet, one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the ogre.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Command Water
entries: The riptide ogre commands water to move in one of the following ways, targeting a creature the ogre can see within 30 feet of it. The ogre must be within 30 feet of a Small or larger body of water to use this bonus action. • Crashing Wave. A wave of water rushes over the creature, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be pushed up to 15 feet in a direction of the ogre’s choice. • Geyser Spout. The target must succeed on a DC 14 DEX save or be thrown up to 30 feet into the air by a geyser of water, taking falling damage if it lands on a solid surface. • Whirlpool. A vortex of water surrounds the creature, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be restrained until the end of its next turn. 225 O O Ogre, Umbral A hulking humanoid with purple skin and glowing eyes raises their axe high, preparing to cleave anything coming near.

bonus.name: Giants in Shadow
entries: Umbral ogres are native to the Plane of Shadow, where they are an integral part of the societal structure of the faerie courts. Though resembling other ogres in size and build, they tend to have magical abilities and greater intelligence. Where other ogres might serve as muscle for an operation, umbral ogres can take on many roles. Some even hold diplomatic or advisory positions at court.

bonus.name: Urban Dwellers
entries: Umbral ogres are found primarily in towns and cities within the Plane of Shadow. They tend to form tight-knit communities, and entire neighborhoods can be populated by an extended family.

bonus.name: Memory Eaters
entries: Perhaps due to their time among the fey or as a side effect of their ancestors’ adaptation to shadow, umbral ogres have a taste for the memories of other sentient beings. Though they can subsist on more traditional foods, meals incorporating memories are a particular delight. These memories typically come from willing participants, but a desperate ogre addicted to particular memories might resort to forcibly extracting them from whomever they can catch. A victim of such violence is dazed and disoriented for hours or days afterward and often has no awareness of what was taken— or that anything was taken at all.

trait.name: Plant Resilience
entries: The rosetta is resistant to exhaustion and to the paralyzed, petrified, and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: Thorn Body
entries: A creature grappling the rosetta takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage at the start of each of the rosetta’s turns.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, and the target is vulnerable to the charmed condition for 1 minute. The target can make a DC 12 WIS save at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Rose Oil Bomb
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) poison damage, and the target is vulnerable to the charmed condition for 1 minute. The target can make a DC 12 WIS save at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Perfume
entries: The rosetta sends a puff of pleasant-smelling perfume toward one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 CHA save or be charmed until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Barbed Restraint
entries: When a creature the rosetta can see moves to a space within 15 feet of the rosetta, it can cause tough brambles to grow and tangle around the creature’s legs. The creature must succeed on a DC 12 DEX save or be restrained until the end of its next turn. 255 R R

trait.name: Freezing Aura
entries: At the start of each of the rune lindwurm’s turns, each creature within 10 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) cold damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The rune lindwurm has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The rune lindwurm’s weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Weak Wings
entries: The rune lindwurm can fly up to 40 feet on its turn, but it must start and end its movement on a solid surface such as a roof or the ground. If it is flying at the end of its turn, it falls to the ground and takes falling damage. R R 256

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rune lindwurm makes one Bite attack, two Claw attacks, and one Tail Pick attack, or it makes four Resin Spit attacks. If two Resin Spit attacks hit one creature, the target’s speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10+ 6) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail Pick
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 STR save or be pulled up to 10 feet toward the lindwurm.

action.name: Resin Spit
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Resinous Breath (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The rune lindwurm exhales sticky resin in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 DEX save. On a failure, a creature takes 38 (11d6) bludgeoning damage and is restrained for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t restrained. A creature, including the restrained creature, can take its action to free the creature by succeeding on a DC 18 STR check. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more or fails the save while already restrained by resin is petrified in resin instead.

reaction.name: Vengeful Runes
entries: When the rune lindwurm takes damage, it can surge freezing power through its runes. Each creature within 5 feet of the lindwurm must succeed on a DC 18 CON save or take 9 (2d8) cold damage. Salamander, Flamescale The reptilian humanoid raises its pronged polearm with a battle cry, flames flaring around it.

reaction.name: Elemental Commanders
entries: Flamescale salamanders serve as leaders within the armies of salamanders and other fiery elementals. Though they share much in common with their lesser kin, flamescales are often distinguished by their burning frill and the trail of fire they leave in their wake.

reaction.name: Bringers of Flame
entries: Flamescale salamanders radiate heat, not only burning those who touch them but setting the very landscape alight. More than one village has been destroyed by one’s presence. While on the Material Plane, they are drawn to locales of volcanic activity, basking on the heated rocks and soaking in the lava pools.

monster.name: Salvager
languages: understands the languages of its creator

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The salvager doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Construct Resilience
entries: The salvager is immune to poison and psychic damage, and it is immune to exhaustion and the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.

trait.name: Internal Compartment
entries: The salvager has a hollow compartment within its torso, accessed through small doors in its stomach. The salvager can hold up to 600 pounds or one Small creature within this space. A creature in the compartment can take its action to escape by succeeding on a DC 15 STR check.

trait.name: Metal Sense
entries: The salvager can magically pinpoint the location of metal, such as coins or plate armor, within 60 feet of it and can sense the general direction of such objects within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The salvager deals double damage to objects and structures. S S 258

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The salvager makes two Buzzsaw attacks and one Grabbing Pincer attack, or it makes three Buzzsaw attacks.

action.name: Buzzsaw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Grabbing Pincer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft. one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the salvager can’t make Grabbing Pincer attacks against other creatures.

action.name: Buzz Spin (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The salvager spins its torso with its buzzsaw arm extended, cutting into those nearby. Each creature within 15 feet of the salvager must make a DC 15 DEX save, taking 44 (8d10) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Magnetic Pull
entries: The salvager magically pulls one Medium or smaller metal object, Construct made primarily of metal, or creature wearing metal armor that it can see within 15 feet of it. If the target metal object is being worn or carried, the creature wearing or carrying the object is pulled if it doesn’t use a reaction to release the object. A metal object that isn’t being worn or carried is pulled up to 15 feet and into the salvager’s compartment. A pulled creature must succeed on a DC 15 STR save or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the salvager and grappled (escape DC 15) by the Grabbing Pincer, if the salvager isn’t already grappling a creature.

trait.name: Painful Gift
entries: When a creature would be poisoned by the samum, that creature can choose for one of its allies within 30 feet of it that isn’t poisoned to be poisoned instead. If a creature does so, its chosen ally takes 2 (1d4) psychic damage and is poisoned for the duration the original creature would have been poisoned.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The samum makes three Claw or Sand Bolt attacks. If two attacks hit one creature, the target is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

action.name: Sand Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, and the samum can choose for the target to be pushed up to 15 feet away from the samum.

action.name: Travel the Planes (1/Day)
entries: The samum transports itself to a different plane of existence. This works like the plane shift spell, except it can affect only itself and can’t use this action to banish an unwilling creature.

bonus.name: Invoke Betrayal
entries: The samum sends tendrils of poison toward one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 17 CON save, taking 7 (2d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A target that fails the save can force an ally it can see within 30 feet of it to take the damage instead. That ally doesn’t make a save, takes the damage, and is also poisoned for 1 minute. The poisoned creature can make a DC 17 CON at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. 149 G G Giant, Deadeye

bonus.name: A giant emerges from the trees, a patch over one of its eyes
entries: Its gaze is erratic, as if tracking things beyond mortal ken.

bonus.name: Legendary Sacrifice
entries: Deadeye giants are an offshoot of frost giants. Their legends describe a savage white dragon decimating their tribe’s ranks. Determined to save his people, the tribe’s patriarch consulted with an ancient hag, who showed him a ritual to glimpse the future. However, he had to first gouge out one of his eyes and then bind it with spell and sigil. The giant did so, burying his dead eye deep beneath the roots of an alder tree, and that night, he saw his first visions. The future opened, revealing many roads, many destinations. On his return, each adult in the tribe repeated the ritual, and with their newfound vision, they slew the dragon. Ever since, those of the tribe each perform the ritual when they come of age.

bonus.name: Thread of Chaos
entries: As a side effect of the ritual, several of each generation are overcome with the visions—too many, too fast—leaving them unable to effectively distinguish dream from reality. Such afflicted giants are said to be infected with the Thread of Chaos and are often driven into exile or killed by the tribe.

bonus.name: Divine Pattern
entries: Deadeye giants revere something they call the Divine Pattern. They believe they work toward one true future—one in which they will be elevated and reign over others—and they believe their glimpses of the future are but small portions of this cosmic pattern. Those infected by the Thread of Chaos are driven out so that their disorder can’t disrupt the Pattern.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the sargassum stalker remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal patch of sargassum.

trait.name: Plant Resilience
entries: The plant is resistant to exhaustion and to the paralyzed, petrified, and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: Thorned Tendrils
entries: The sargassum stalker can have up to ten Thorned Tendrils at a time. Each Thorned Tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 20 HP; vulnerable to slashing damage; immune to psychic damage). Destroying a Thorned Tendril deals no damage to the sargassum stalker, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn. If a tendril takes at least 10 damage while grappling a creature, it is severed from the sargassum stalker, the grappled target is freed, and the stalker can no longer control the tendril. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), each severed tendril makes one attack against a creature within 30 feet of it, dealing only half the normal damage on a hit. Then roll a d6. On a 1–4, the tendril crumbles and is destroyed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sargassum stalker makes one Consuming Core attack and two Thorned Tendril attacks, or it makes four Thorned Tendril attacks. Alternatively, it can make four Toss Meal Remnants attacks.

action.name: Consuming Core
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 37 (6d10 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Thorned Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the sargassum stalker can’t use the same Thorned Tendril on another target.

action.name: Toss Meal Remnants
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (the sargassum’s choice) plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

bonus.name: Reel
entries: The sargassum stalker pulls each creature grappled by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

bonus.name: Rending Constrict
entries: The sargassum stalker saws into up to two creatures grappled by it.. Each target must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or take 9 (2d8) piercing damage. 259 S S

trait.name: Air Form
entries: The sawgrass zephyr can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The elemental doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Elemental Resilience
entries: The elemental is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: Grasslands Camouflage
entries: The sawgrass zephyr’s Stealth is 22 while in tall grass or foliage. S S 260

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sawblade zephyr makes three Grassy Claw attacks.

action.name: Grassy Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Sawblade Gust (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The sawblade zephyr blasts sharp-edged grass in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 DEX save, taking 25 (10d4) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Fling
entries: One Medium or smaller creature in the sawgrass zephyr’s space must succeed on a DC 15 STR save or be thrown up to 20 feet away from the elemental in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes an object, such as a wall or floor, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 DEX save or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

reaction.name: Gusting Juke
entries: When the sawblade zephyr is the target of a ranged attack, it can cause swirling wind to redirect that attack toward another creature or point on the ground the zephyr can see within 30 feet of it, provided that target is within the attack’s range. The attacker must succeed on a DC 15 DEX save or the attack is redirected.

trait.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The scaled war weasel is considered to be a Large animal for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

trait.name: Dedicated Tunneler
entries: If the scaled war weasel burrows at half its burrowing speed, it can leave a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Formicbane Companion
entries: The scaled war weasel doesn’t take damage from a formicbane’s Spiked Mane when it touches a formicbane or when a formicbane rides it.

trait.name: Heightened Hearing and Smell
entries: The weasel’s Perception is 16 when perceiving by hearing or smell.

trait.name: Monstrosity Resilience
entries: The monstrosity is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the scaled war weasel moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Bite attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 STR save or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the weasel can make one Claw attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scaled war weasel makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, or it makes three Spit Acid attacks. If two Claw attacks hit one creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 15), if it is a Medium or smaller creature and the weasel isn’t already grappling a creature.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Spit Acid
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) acid damage.

bonus.name: Musk Spray
entries: The scaled war weasel releases a pungent spray in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 CON save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Protect Rider
entries: When a creature the scaled war weasel can see attacks a creature riding it, the weasel can curl around its rider, exposing its armored hide to the attack, and the weasel becomes the target of the attack instead. 261 S S

trait.name: Can Opener
entries: The scavenger has advantage on attack rolls against Constructs and creatures wearing heavy metal armor. In addition, the scavenger deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Scavenged Arsenal
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the scavenger chooses one of the following tools, which remains active until the start of the scavenger’s next turn. • Coward’s Ward. The scavenger has disadvantage on attack rolls, and attack rolls against it have disadvantage. • Glowing Goggles. The scavenger has darkvision to a range of 30 feet but can’t hide or benefit from invisibility. In addition, it can see a faint aura around any creature or object bearing magic within 30 feet of it. • Impatient Boots. The scavenger has a speed of 50 feet but can’t take reactions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scavenger makes three Mattock or Light Crossbow attacks.

action.name: Mattock
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage or slashing damage (the scavenger’s choice).

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Ferrophile Flask (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The scavenger flings a flask at a point it can see within 30 feet of it, which splatters an acidic, magnetic substance. Each creature within 15 feet of that point must make a DC 13 DEX save, taking 14 (4d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Construct made of metal or a creature wearing medium or heavy metal armor that failed the save also has its speed halved until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Warping Spike
entries: The scavenger plants a small spike in the ground on a point it can see within 10 feet of it, activating one of the following effects. The effect is centered on the spike and lasts until the scavenger deactivates it (no action required) or uses this bonus action to plant another spike. • Warp Magic. Each creature within 10 feet of the spike has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects. • Warp Metal. Each Construct made of metal or creature wearing medium or heavy metal armor within 10 feet of the spike reduces the AC granted by that armor by 2.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The scouring cicada can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 2 1/2-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scouring cicada makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Antennae Flare
entries: The scouring cicada releases a jet of flame in 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 12 DEX save, taking 10 (4d4) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Dust Storm
entries: The scouring cicada beats its wings frantically, kicking up a 10-foot-radius cloud of sand. The cloud spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts until the start of the cicada’s next turn or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

reaction.name: Answering Storm
entries: When a friendly scouring cicada uses Dust Storm within 10 feet of this scouring cicada, this cicada can enhance the storm. The dust storm’s radius increases by 5 feet, and its duration increases by 1 round for each cicada enhancing it, to a maximum of 60 feet and 1 minute. If a cicada used this reaction to enhance another cicada’s storm, it can’t use its Dust Storm bonus action while that storm is active.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the scuttleweb remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a pile of dark, sticky webbing.

trait.name: Ooze Nature
entries: The scuttleweb doesn’t require sleep.

trait.name: Ooze Resilience
entries: The scuttleweb is resistant to the grappled and restrained conditions, and it is immune to exhaustion and to the blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, and prone conditions.

trait.name: Point Blank Web Shot
entries: When the scuttleweb makes a Web Shot attack, it doesn’t have disadvantage on the attack roll from being within 5 feet of a hostile creature, provided that creature is restrained by its Web Body or Web Shot.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The scuttleweb can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Body
entries: The scuttleweb can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa. A creature that starts its turn in the scuttleweb’s space must succeed on a DC 17 STR save or be restrained. A restrained creature takes 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns and moves with the scuttleweb when it moves. The scuttleweb can have up to three Large creatures or six Medium or smaller creatures restrained in this way at a time. A creature, including the restrained creature, can take its action to free the restrained creature from the scuttleweb’s sticky body by succeeding on a DC 17 STR check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scuttleweb makes three Pseudopod or Web Shot attacks.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

action.name: Web Shot
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17

action.name: DEX save or be restrained
entries: A creature, including the target, can take its action to free the target from the webbing by succeeding on a DC 17 STR check.

bonus.name: Web Line
entries: The scuttleweb pulls one creature restrained by its Web Shot up to 30 feet toward it. Alternatively, the scuttleweb pulls itself up to 30 feet toward a creature restrained by its Web Shot. 263 S S

trait.name: Monstrosity Resilience
entries: The naga is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

trait.name: Radiant Strikes
entries: The naga’s weapon attacks are magical. When the naga hits with any weapon attack, the weapon deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days, regaining all its HP and becoming active again. Only a wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sea naga makes three Pike attacks or four Lightning Bolt attacks, or it makes one Constrict attack and two Pike attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Constrict
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the naga can’t Constrict another target. N N 216 Pike. Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Lightning Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) lightning damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
entries: The sea naga casts one of the following spells, requiring only verbal components and using WIS as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16). At will: augury (as an action), purify food and drink (as an action), spare the dying , thaumaturgy 3/day each: cure wounds , water breathing 2/day each: control water , sending 1/day: geas (as an action)

bonus.name: Punish Trespasser
entries: One creature the sea naga can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or be unable to breathe water for 1 minute, risking suffocation if underwater. If the target is breathing water through the aid of a spell, magic item, or other magical effect, the effect is suppressed for the duration. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Wave Step
entries: While partially or wholly submerged in water, the sea naga dissolves into water and teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is partially or wholly submerged in water.

monster.name: Sea Snare
senses: keensense 60 ft. (can’t sense beyond this radius)

trait.name: Enticing Aroma
entries: The sea snare emits chemicals into the air and water that cause creatures to smell things they find delicious or otherwise attractive. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the sea snare and that can smell must succeed on a DC 15 WIS save or be charmed until the start of its next turn. A charmed creature that is more than 5 feet away from the sea snare must move on its turn toward the S S 264 sea snare by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn’t avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the sea snare, the target can repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. Unless surprised, a creature can hold its breath to avoid the save at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can’t breathe, speak, or cast spells with verbal components. If the creature stops holding its breath while within 30 feet of the sea snare, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Plant Resilience
entries: The sea snare is resistant to exhaustion and to the paralyzed, petrified, and unconscious conditions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sea snare makes three Trap Jaw attacks.

action.name: Trap Jaw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is Large or smaller. The sea snare has eight trap jaws, but it can’t grapple more than four creatures at a time.

bonus.name: Digest
entries: One creature grappled by the sea snare must make a DC 15 CON save, taking 5 (2d4) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Quick Paddle
entries: The sea snare takes the Dash or Disengage action.

trait.name: Familiar
entries: The searsprite can serve another creature as a familiar, forming a magic, telepathic bond with that willing companion. While the two are bonded, the companion can sense what the searsprite senses as long as they are within 1 mile of each other. While the searsprite is within 10 feet of its companion, the companion is resistant to radiant damage. At any time and for any reason, the searsprite can end its service as a familiar, ending the telepathic bond.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The searsprite doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Elemental Resilience
entries: The searsprite is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: Solar Aura
entries: At the start of each of the searsprite’s turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 2 (1d4) radiant damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren’t being worn or carried ignite.

trait.name: Solar Illumination
entries: The searsprite sheds bright light in a 40 - foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet. The bright light is sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The searsprite makes two Bite or Solar Bolt attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) radiant damage.

action.name: Solar Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) radiant damage.

bonus.name: Irradiate
entries: The searsprite manipulates solar energy clinging to one creature it can see within 30 feet of it that has taken radiant damage within the last minute. The target must succeed on a DC 12 CON save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Blinding Flare
entries: When a creature the searsprite can see attacks it, the searsprite can flare solar energy, and the attacker must succeed on a DC 12 DEX save or be blinded until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Fey Resilience
entries: Selkolla is resistant to the charmed and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: Selkolla can hold her breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Speak with Pinnipeds
entries: Selkolla can communicate with seals, sea lions, and walruses as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Selkolla makes one Bite attack and two Tail attacks, or she makes three Claw or Frost Bolt attacks.

action.name: Bite (Seal Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

action.name: Claw (True Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

action.name: Tail (Seal Form Only)
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frost Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) cold damage, and the target’s speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Freezing Storm (Recharge 6)
entries: Selkolla conjures a freezing tempest around her. Each creature within 20 feet of Selkolla must make a DC 15 CON save. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) cold damage and suffers one level of exhaustion. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn’t suffer exhaustion.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: Selkolla magically transforms into a Large seal or back into her true form, which is Fey. Her statistics, other than her AC, size, and speed are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying transforms with her. She reverts to her true form if she dies. 133 F F Fey Lady, Tynan The tall, statuesque woman is veiled in shadow, her full form hidden. The lean lines of her regal face are lit from below by the glowing red orb she carries, reflecting off her eyes—and the eyes of the beasts lurking in the shadows with her.

bonus.name: Twilit Queen
entries: Tynan, the Twilight Queen, rules over those liminal times between day and night, dawn and dusk, over the fleeting moments of both hope and despair. She represents both the return of the light and the descent into darkness, anticipation and foreboding. Her court is a mix of light and shadow, and likewise, this sovereign is alternately either dark and brooding or light and inspiring.

bonus.name: Living Between Moments
entries: Dominion over such brief segments of time both limits and expands her power. Decisions made on the cusp of such change hold lasting sway and must be made wisely. Dealings with this fey noble can have powerful outcomes, but the costs are often great. Many are the crepuscular creatures that move through her domain, and it is said that some such gazes brim with intelligence, rumored to be petitioners who paid a high price and are now tied to her domain as beasts.

bonus.name: Twilit Regalia
entries: Tynan carries items of power, royal regalia signifying her claim as the Twilight Queen: notably, the Cervid Scepter, a rosewood scepter banded in gold, its top carved to resemble a deer’s head, and the Red Sun Orb, a powerful scrying device. These items are bound to her and reappear in her hands if ever stolen. And the foxes found throughout her realm are said to be what became of those thieves. TYNAN’S LAIR Tynan’s court is known as the Court of the Red Sun, and she resides in a palace woven from living trees, called the

bonus.name: Halls of Dawn and Dusk
entries: Cats, deer, foxes, and rabbits proliferate in the wild glades around the halls, and bats and owls flit silently through the trees, whose long shadows crisscross a landscape painted in the flickers of eternal twilight. LAIR ACTIONS On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Tynan can take a lair action to cause one of the following effects; she can’t use the same effect two rounds in a row: • Beast Parade. Bats, deer, foxes, owls, and other crepuscular animals come streaming through the area, a brief tide of frantic motion. The animals sweep through the area in a 60-foot line that is 15 feet wide before disappearing. Each hostile creature in the line must succeed on a DC 17 F F 134 DEX save or it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes and its speed is halved until initiative count 20 on the next round. • Long Shadows Linger. Up to three shadows stretch across the area, each a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide, starting on points Tynan can see within 120 feet of her. Each line of shadow is 10 feet high and is magical darkness. The shadows last for 1 minute, until Tynan uses this lair action again, or until Tynan dies. • Twilight Orbs. Twilight falls on up to two points Tynan can see within 120 feet of her. The areas within 15 feet of each point change to magical dim light, brightening dark areas or darkening bright areas. Effects that create light or darkness, other than those created by Tynan or her lair, are suppressed while in this area. These areas of twilight last for 1 minute, until Tynan uses this lair action again, or until Tynan dies. REGIONAL EFFECTS The region containing Tynan’s lair is warped by her magic, which creates one or more of the following effects: • Emboldened Beasts. Crepuscular animals, those most active at dawn or dusk (such as bats, owls, nighthawks, deer, rabbits, and foxes), are more common within 5 miles of the lair, and they are bold, showing little to no fear toward humanoids. • Heightened Emotional States. Within 10 miles of the lair, creatures with an INT of −2 or higher have strong feelings of anticipation—whether this expresses itself as anxiousness or hopefulness depends on the individual—especially in liminal locations (passing through doorways or cave entrances, standing on the shore between land and sea, and similar) or at liminal moments (births, deaths, the end of an endeavor, the start of a new project, and similar). • Lingering Twilight. Within 10 miles of the lair, sunrises and sunsets seem to last for an unsettling amount of time, and within 1 mile of the lair, the land is shrouded in perpetual twilight. In this twilight, the position of the sun seems to switch from east to west and back again whenever one’s attention is distracted. If Tynan dies, these effects fade in 1d10 days.

trait.name: Devil’s Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn’t impede the devil’s darkvision.

trait.name: Devilish Resistance
entries: The devil is resistant to cold damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to fire damage and poison damage and to the poisoned condition.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The servitor of Abizeth makes two Bite attacks and one Viper Tail attack, or it makes two Envenomed Javelin attacks. It can replace one Bite attack with a Flaming Chain attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

action.name: Flaming Chain
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and target is grappled (escape DC 15). D D 96 Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the servitor can’t use its Flaming Chain on another target.

action.name: Viper Tail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 CON save or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Envenomed Javelin
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a

action.name: DC 15 CON save or be poisoned for 1 minute
entries: The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Twist Chain
entries: A creature grappled by the servitor’s Flaming Chain must make a DC 15 STR save, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Spiked Shield Parry
entries: The servitor of Abizeth adds 3 to its

reaction.name: AC against one melee attack that would hit it
entries: To do so, the servitor of Abizeth must see the attacker and be wielding a shield. If the attack misses, the attacker takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage. Devil, Automata A nightmare wrapped in chains and held together by whirring gears, the fiend howls like a hurricane and readies for battle.

reaction.name: Guards and Overseers
entries: Sometimes called castigas, automata devils are made to monitor others. They are often put in charge of prisoners or infernal factories.

reaction.name: Pierced by Chain and Wire
entries: This slender creature’s skin is pierced with barbs, sharp nails, and coils of wire, which have been threaded through its flesh. Chains are buried under blisters and scabs. This infernal horror’s eyelids are sewn open with wire while six arms ending in large grasping hands erupt from its shoulders.

reaction.name: Coiled Metal Whips
entries: The creature’s head is a dark mass, ending in two large mandibles. At its side, it carries a huge coiled whip that squirms like a snake and is said to sniff out lies and treachery. The creature’s stomach opens like a second mouth, lined with tooth-like spines.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The shadow fey confidante is resistant to the charmed condition, and magic can’t put the shadow fey to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow fey confidante has disadvantage on attack rolls, and its Perception is 7 when perceiving by sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadow fey confidante makes two Barbed

action.name: Words attacks and one Bladed Fan attack
entries: It can replace one attack with Honeyed Tongue, if available.

action.name: Barbed Words
entries: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) psychic damage.

action.name: Bladed Fan
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

action.name: Honeyed Tongue (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The shadow fey confidante speaks irresistible words in a sweet voice to a creature it can see, and that can hear the confidante, within 30 feet of it. The target must make a DC 14 WIS save or be charmed for 1 hour. If the charmed creature takes damage from an effect other than the confidante’s Barbed Words, it can repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Chatelaine
entries: The shadow fey confidante imbues one of the charms from its chatelaine with magic, activating an effect unique to the charm. The confidante can’t imbue the same charm two rounds in a row. • Bell. A clanging bell rings in the minds of up to three creatures the confidante can see within 20 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 14 WIS save or be stunned until the end of its next turn. • Coin. The confidante changes the liquid in one drinking vessel it can see within 10 feet of it into poison. A creature that imbibes the poison must succeed on a DC 14 CON save or be poisoned for 1 hour. • Flask. The confidante regains 11 (2d8 + 2) HP. • Hourglass. Time pulls at up to three creatures the confidante can see within 20 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 14 WIS save or its speed is halved and it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. • Pendant. The confidante ends one condition affecting it.

bonus.name: Shadow Traveler (2/Day)
entries: While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the shadow fey confidante disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action. 125 E E

trait.name: Fey Resilience
entries: The hag is resistant to the charmed and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: Shadow’s Sight
entries: The shadow hag’s Perception is 18 while in dim light or darkness, and magical darkness doesn’t impede the hag’s darkvision.

trait.name: Sup Fear
entries: When the hag starts its turn within 30 feet of a blinded or frightened creature, the hag gains one of the following benefits: • Frightful Rejuvenation. The hag regains 7 (2d6) HP. • Tormenting Leverage. The hag has advantage on the next Shadow Claw or Shadow Bolt attack it makes. • Unceasing Fright. One blinded or frightened creature the hag can see within 30 feet of it has disadvantage on the next save it makes to end the condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadow hag makes two Shadow Claw attacks or three Shadow Bolt attacks. H H 174 Shadow Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

action.name: Shadow Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) cold damage.

action.name: Lost in Darkness (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The hag sends shadows to envelop up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 15 WIS save. On a failure, a creature takes 22 (5d8) psychic damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t blinded. A creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Frightful Allies (1/Day)
entries: The hag magically calls 1d4 shadows . They arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the hag and obeying its spoken commands. The creatures remain for 1 hour, until the hag dies, or until the hag dismisses them as a bonus action.

action.name: Spellcasting
entries: The shadow hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no verbal components and using CHA as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15). At will: darkness , minor illusion , prestidigitation 3/day each: fear , fog cloud

bonus.name: Shadow Step
entries: The shadow hag teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The origin and destination spaces must be in dim light or darkness.

trait.name: Fey Resilience
entries: The shadowcaller is resistant to the charmed and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: Shadow Duplicates
entries: At the start of each of the shadowcaller’s turns, it can manifest shadowy duplicates of itself. It can have up to three of these duplicates at a time. A manifested duplicate appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the shadowcaller. The shadowcaller has full control of the duplicates, can sense through their senses, and can move each up to 30 feet during the shadowcaller’s turn (no action required), including through spaces as narrow as 1 inch wide. Any duplicates more than 60 feet away from the shadowcaller at the start of the shadowcaller’s turn fade and can be manifested anew. Each shadow duplicate is friendly to the shadowcaller and hostile to its enemies, but duplicates otherwise can’t attack, are mindless creatures, and can be attacked and destroyed (AC 15; HP 15; resistant to all damage). Destroying a duplicate deals no damage to the shadowcaller.

trait.name: Shadow Weapons
entries: The shadowcaller’s weapon attacks are magical. When the shadowcaller hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d6 cold damage (included in the attack). S S 266 Shadow’s Reach. When the shadowcaller makes a melee weapon attack, it can attack through one of its shadow duplicates, targeting a creature within 5 feet of the duplicate, provided the duplicate is within 60 feet of the shadowcaller. If it does so, all damage dealt by the attack is cold.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadowcaller makes three Scimitar or Shadow Bolt attacks.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage.

action.name: Shadow Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) cold damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Step
entries: The shadowcaller teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The origin and destination must be in dim light or darkness.

reaction.name: Shadow Switch (75 HP or Fewer)
entries: When the shadowcaller is attacked, it can teleport into the space of one of its duplicates, and the duplicate teleports into the space it left, becoming the new target of the attack.

trait.name: Demonic Resilience
entries: The shanlayu is resistant to cold, fire, and lightning damage. In addition, it is immune to poison damage and to the poisoned condition.

trait.name: Lightning-Infused Weapons
entries: The shanlayu’s weapon attacks are magical. When the shanlayu hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d6 lightning damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shanlayu has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Storm Caller
entries: Nearby weather responds to the shanlayu’s desires. At the start of each minute, the shanlayu can choose to change the precipitation and wind within 3 miles of it by one stage, up or down (no action required). This effect works like the changing weather conditions aspect of the control weather spell, except the conditions change immediately and the shanlayu can’t reduce the precipitation below overcast or the wind below moderate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shanlayu makes three Spear or Lightning Bolt attacks. If two attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 18 CON save or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn. D D 92 Spear. Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands, plus 14 (4d6) lightning damage.

action.name: Lightning Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) lightning damage.

action.name: Arcing Lightning (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The shanlayu sends a great arc of lightning toward one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. Lightning hits that creature, then bounces to a different creature the shanlayu can see within 15 feet of the first creature, and finally, bounces to a different creature the shanlayu can see within 15 feet of the second creature. Each target must make a DC 18 DEX save, taking 49 (14d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The first creature has disadvantage on the save if the shanlayu is within 1 mile of a storm.

bonus.name: Lightning Step
entries: The shanlayu teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it in a flash of lightning. This distance increases to 120 feet if the shanlayu is within 1 mile of a storm. Each creature within 5 feet of the origin and destination spaces must make a DC 18 DEX save, taking 10 (3d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Demon, Styx Lurking in the shallows of the black water, the demon— luminescent spots along its form—opens wide its massive, fanged maw and hisses in annoyance.

bonus.name: Cunning Allies
entries: These riverine demons prowl riverbanks and devour the incautious. They are especially common along the Rivers Styx and Lethe and other dark or haunted rivers, mires, and marshes. They are feared for their cunning, and they often ally with dark priests or other demons.

bonus.name: Servants of Death
entries: Styx demons are more intelligent than the average demon, and many of them worship and serve gods of death, murder, or blood. They often lead packs of dretches, husk demons, mire fiends, quasits, and other demons (see Monster Vault for all), and many dark priests find them invaluable for capturing mortals for sacrifice. The demons occasionally wear an amulet or unholy symbol that shows their allegiance to a particular god.

bonus.name: River Princes
entries: Some styx demons command floating fortresses on wide river barges, occupied by lesser demons, cultists, and bandits. Known as demon princes, these clever demons hold their own minor courts and command respect among even more powerful demons.

monster.name: Shatterstar
languages: understands the languages of its creators but

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The shatterstar doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Construct Resilience
entries: The shatterstar is immune to poison and psychic damage, and it is immune to exhaustion and the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The shatterstar regains 5 HP at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 HP.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shatterstar makes two Metal Shard attacks.

action.name: Metal Shard
entries: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Shrapnel Blast (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The shatterstar slams into a point on a solid surface, such as the ground or a wall, within 5 feet of it, causing a small explosion of metal shards. Each creature within 15 feet of that point must make a DC 13 DEX save, taking 10 (4d4) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After using this action, the shatterstar’s AC is reduced by 2 until the start of its next turn.

reaction.name: Pressurized Rebuke
entries: When a creature the shatterstar can see hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the shatterstar can release a burst of pressurized air at the creature. The attacker must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be blinded until the end of its next turn. 267 S S

trait.name: Celestial Resilience
entries: The shimmer mole is resistant to radiant damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shimmer mole has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The shimmer mole’s weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Radiant Illumination
entries: The shimmer mole sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. If any of the light overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 2nd circle or lower, the spell creating the darkness is dispelled. S S 268 Radiant Tunneler. The shimmer mole can burrow through solid rock. If it burrows at half its burrowing speed, it can leave a 5-foot diameter tunnel in its wake. This tunnel is illuminated for up to 8 hours, shedding the same light as described in the Radiant Illumination trait. For the duration, an Aberration, Fiend, or Undead that enters the tunnel for the first time on a turn or starts its turn in the tunnel must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or take 4 (1d8) radiant damage. In addition, a creature that isn’t an Aberration, Fiend, or Undead that spends a short rest in the tunnel recovers twice the HP when expending hit dice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shimmer mole makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

action.name: Radiant Spire
entries: The shimmer mole sends spires of earth up from the ground toward up to two creatures it can sense on the ground within 30 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 13 DEX save, taking 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Radiant Retribution
entries: When an attack hits the shimmer mole, it can create an intense flash of light within 5 feet of it. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 DEX save or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The shoreline drake can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Heightened Sight and Smell
entries: The shoreline drake’s Perception is 17 when perceiving by sight or smell.

trait.name: Oceanic Protector
entries: The shoreline drake has advantage on attack rolls against Large or larger creatures that have a swimming speed.

trait.name: Speak with Pinnipeds
entries: The shoreline drake can communicate with seals, sea lions, and walruses as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shoreline drake makes one Beak attack, two Claw attacks, and one Wing Slap attack.

action.name: Beak
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Wing Slap
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be pushed up to 5 feet away from the drake.

action.name: Icy Stream (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The shoreline drake exhales icy water in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 14 DEX save, taking 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and 14 (4d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Winged Push
entries: If a Large or smaller creature moves into a space within 5 feet of the shoreline drake, the drake can push that creature away from it. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the drake. The creature has disadvantage on the save if both it and the drake are underwater. 119 D D Drake, Stonefish

reaction.name: The ground trembles and bursts in a spray of rubble
entries: A crimson-eyed crocodilian beast lunges while flaring the spined sail on its back.

reaction.name: Built for Badlands
entries: With its dun coloration, compact form, heavy jaws, and ability to move through earth and sand as if they were water, the stonefish drake melts into the terrain. Their body shape can cause some to mistake them for dinosaurs, but any combat with one quickly corrects that misconception.

reaction.name: Death from Below
entries: As ambush predators, stonefish drakes burst out of the ground to take prey by surprise. They can quickly rise to become apex predators of their otherwise sparse ecological space. They craft extended warrens with meandering, subterranean dens that are often littered with the bones and detritus of their kills.

reaction.name: Burrowing Hunter
entries: Stonefish drakes often hunt other burrowing creatures, and while prairie dogs, snakes, and ferrets make up a large portion of their diets, they find mirror drakes and rampedes (both in this book) especially delicious. This appetite leads many merchant caravans and remote communities to broker deals of protection with the drakes when plagued by those creatures.

trait.name: Celestial Resilience
entries: The shrine keeper is resistant to radiant damage.

trait.name: Incense Nimbus
entries: The shrine keeper is perpetually surrounded by a nimbus of strong-smelling, soporific incense. A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the shrine keeper must succeed on a DC 12 CON save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more falls unconscious. On a success, the creature is immune to the shrine keeper’s Incense Nimbus for 24 hours.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
