entries: The shrine keeper has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The shrine keeper’s weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Pummel
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

action.name: Coldfire Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) cold damage.

action.name: Caretaker’s Touch
entries: The shrine keeper casts the mending cantrip, requiring no material components and using WIS as the spellcasting ability.

action.name: Comet Dive (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The shrine keeper becomes a miniature, fiery comet and dives at a point it can see within 5 feet of it. Each creature within 15 feet of that point must make a DC 12 DEX save. On a failure, a creature takes 7 (2d6) cold damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t knocked prone.

bonus.name: Protector’s Step
entries: The shrine keeper magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space within the shrine it protects or within 30 feet of the exterior of the shrine. Swirls of fire the same color as the keeper appear at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action. 269 S S

monster.name: Sidhe Ox
languages: understands Common and Sylvan but can’t speak

trait.name: Fey Resilience
entries: The sidhe ox is resistant to the charmed and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: Impossible Hauler
entries: The sidhe ox is considered to be a Gargantuan animal for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity. In addition, it can magically pull, drag, or haul any object or structure, given a sturdy harness and enough time. The ox can move a Gargantuan or smaller object or structure up to 40 feet per minute, even if that object or structure can’t ordinarily be moved. For larger objects or structures, like a mountain or multi-floor building, this is reduced to 1 foot per hour, increasing by 1 foot for each additional sidhe ox pulling the same object or structure. Moving an object or structure in this way doesn’t harm it, disrupt its foundation, or otherwise damage it, but the final destination could be inherently dangerous, such as pulling it into a river, leaving it teetering on a cliff, or putting it in S S 270 the path of lava. Similarly, the ground beneath the object or structure or in its path isn’t damaged or disturbed by the movement. The earth seems to fold around the object as it is moved, leaving its original location looking as if the object had never been there and the destination looking as if the object always belonged there.

trait.name: Rooted in the Earth
entries: The sidhe ox can’t be moved against its will.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sidhe ox makes one Gore attack and two Hoof attacks. If both Hoof attacks hit one creature, the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the ox or knocked prone (the ox’s choice).

action.name: Gore
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Hoof
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Earthen Low
entries: The sidhe ox releases a deep, rumbling low in a 30-foot cone, calling to the earth. Plants in the area experience a sudden burst of growth, turning the area into difficult terrain until the start of the ox’s next turn. This difficult terrain doesn’t cost the ox extra movement.

monster.name: Silt Lurker
senses: keensense 60 ft. (can’t sense beyond this radius)

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Ooze Resilience
entries: The ooze is resistant to the grappled and restrained conditions, and it is immune to exhaustion and to the blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, and prone conditions.

trait.name: River Camouflage
entries: The silt lurker’s Stealth is 16 while in silty or algae-filled water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The silt lurker makes two Chomp attacks.

action.name: Chomp
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage, and the target is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Algal Bloom (Recharge 5–6)
entries: While underwater, the silt lurker releases a burst of toxic algae. Each creature within 15 feet of the silt lurker must make a DC 13 CON save. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Toxic Rub
entries: The silt lurker rubs its algae-filled body against one creature it can see within 5 feet of it that is poisoned by it, enhancing the poison. The target must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn. VARIANT SILT LURKER: ICE ALGAE LURKER Some silt lurkers form when magical or alchemical run-off infuses arctic algae. A silt lurker symbiotically linked to ice algae is immune to cold damage, and its Toxic Rub action petrifies the target in ice instead of paralyzing. In addition, the ice algae lurker replaces its Algal Bloom action with the following: Freezing Spray (Recharge 5–6). The ice algae lurker releases shards of frozen ooze in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 DEX save, taking 5 (2d4) piercing damage and 10 (3d6) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is also petrified in ice for 1 minute or until it takes fire damage. 271 S S

monster.name: Skeleton Lord
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: As the zombie lord.

trait.name: Master Tactician
entries: The skeleton lord and any friendly Undead within 30 feet of it have advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the lord’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: As the zombie lord.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: As the zombie lord.

trait.name: Undead Resilience
entries: As the zombie lord.

trait.name: Unshakeable Command
entries: Each friendly Undead within 30 feet of the skeleton lord can’t be charmed or frightened while the commander isn’t incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skeleton lord makes three Dread Blade or Necrotic Bolt attacks.

action.name: Dread Blade
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 CON save or its HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its HP maximum to 0.

action.name: Necrotic Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) necrotic damage.

bonus.name: General’s Command
entries: The skeleton lord commands up to two friendly Undead it can see within 30 feet of it to assist it. Each target uses its reaction to make one attack against a creature the lord attacked this round.

reaction.name: Necrotic Counter
entries: When a creature the skeleton lord can see within 30 feet of it hits it with an attack, the lord can release a wave of necrotic energy. The attacker must succeed on a DC 17 CON save or take 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The skeleton lord moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Grasp of the Grave (Costs 2 Action)
entries: Each non-Undead creature within 15 feet of the skeleton lord must succeed on a DC 17 DEX save or be restrained by skeletal hands until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Stay on Your Feet (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The skeleton lord issues a stern command to up to three friendly Undead it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target’s AC increases by 2 until the end of its next turn, and each target gains 9 (2d8) temporary HP. 297 U U

trait.name: Heightened Smell
entries: The skunk’s Perception is 16 while perceiving by smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

action.name: Spray (Recharge 6)
entries: The skunk raises its tail and sprays noxious gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 10 DEX save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn and stink. Until the creature that stinks spends 10 minutes washing with soap, creatures have advantage on WIS (Perception) checks to detect it by smell. 327

trait.name: Heightened Smell
entries: The skunk’s Perception is 17 while perceiving by smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skunk makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

action.name: Spray (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The skunk raises its tail and sprays noxious gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 12 DEX save. On a failure, a creature takes 5 (2d4) poison damage, is poisoned for 1 minute, and stinks. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, is poisoned until the end of its next turn, and doesn’t stink. A poisoned creature can make a DC 12 CON save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Until the creature that stinks spends 10 minutes washing with soap, creatures have advantage on WIS (Perception) checks to detect it by smell.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the slaughter hide remains motionless and prone, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate animal hide.

trait.name: Flattened Form
entries: The slaughter hide can move through any opening large enough for a Small creature. It can squeeze through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The slaughter hide doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Undead Resilience
entries: The slaughter hide is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaughter hide makes two Leather Tendril attacks. If both attacks hit one creature that isn’t grappled, the target is knocked prone.

action.name: Leather Tendril
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13) if it is a Large or smaller S S 272 creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the slaughter hide can’t use that Leather Tendril to attack another target. The slaughter hide can have up to two targets grappled at a time.

action.name: Squeeze Prey
entries: The slaughter hide tightens around one creature it is grappling. The target must make a DC 13 STR save, taking 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A breathing creature that fails this save by 5 or more has the remaining air squeezed from its lungs and begins suffocating.

bonus.name: Project Terror
entries: The slaughter hide projects the pain and terror of its mortal life into the mind of one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 WIS save or fall prone and be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The mephit can move through a space at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of sludge. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 11 CON save or be petrified for 1 minute. A petrified creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: As the glass mephit.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the mephit remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary pile of mud.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Muck Ball
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 CON save or have its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Sludge Breath (Recharge 6)
entries: The mephit exhales thick sludge in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 DEX save. On a failure, a creature takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and is restrained by sludge until the end of its next turn. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn’t restrained.

bonus.name: Mud Slick (1/Day)
entries: The mephit casts the grease spell (spell save DC 11), requiring no material components and using WIS as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Charged Weapons
entries: When the soarer hits with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d6 lightning damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The soarer doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

trait.name: Hawkeye
entries: The soarer’s Perception is 20 when perceiving by sight, and it can make ranged attacks at long distance with no penalty.

trait.name: Storm Rider
entries: The soarer can fly in high winds, precipitation, and stormy weather without needing to make an ability check, and moving through such weather doesn’t cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Shared Flight
entries: Each friendly creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the soarer has a flying speed of 30 feet until the start of its next turn. The soarer can choose for a creature to not be affected by this trait.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The soarer makes two Claw or Longbow attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

bonus.name: Wing Gust
entries: The soarer flaps its wings, releasing a magical gust of wind in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be pushed up to 15 feet away from the soarer. If a creature has a flying speed and fails the save, it loses the ability to fly until the end of its next turn, falling and taking falling damage if it is currently flying. Soarers are immune to this special effect. 273 S S

trait.name: Giant Attributes
entries: The soilsinger is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The soilsinger’s Stealth is 17 while in any terrain with ample, obscuring plant life.

trait.name: Speak with Plants
entries: The soilsinger can communicate with Plants and nonmagical plants as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The soilsinger makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

action.name: Druid’s Care
entries: The soilsinger casts the druidcraft cantrip, using WIS as the spellcasting ability, or one Plant it touches regains 4 (1d8) HP.

bonus.name: Earth Song
entries: The soilsinger sings at a point on the ground it can see within 30 feet of it, causing the earth to churn around that point. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be knocked prone. The area is difficult terrain for 1 minute or until the soilsinger uses this bonus action again.

bonus.name: Unsettling Song
entries: The soilsinger sings a deep, rumbling song toward one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 CON save or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn, as the song reverberates uncomfortably within it.

trait.name: Aura of Haywire Magic
entries: When a creature casts a spell within 20 feet of the gremlin, the creature must succeed on a DC 12 CON save or the spell goes haywire. A haywire spell targets random, valid targets within the spell’s range.

trait.name: Fey Resilience
entries: The gremlin is resistant to the charmed and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The gremlin has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sense Magic
entries: The gremlin senses and can pinpoint the location of magic within 120 feet of it. If it senses magic and can see the creature or object bearing the magic it senses, it sees a faint aura around that creature or object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spellbane gremlin makes two Bite or Spellbane Bolt attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

action.name: Spellbane Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) force damage. If the target is a spellcaster, it has disadvantage on the next save it makes before the start of the gremlin’s next turn.

reaction.name: Haywire Redirect
entries: When a spell cast by a spellcaster within 30 feet of the gremlin goes haywire because of any spellbane gremlin’s Aura of Haywire Magic, the gremlin can redirect the spell, choosing the spell’s targets. The chosen targets must be valid targets for the spell. 171 G G Hag, Field What at first appeared to be a scarecrow in the field is rather a green-hued woman. She wears grass-woven clothing adorned with stalks of wheat and thistly brambles, and grasshoppers and locusts play about her hair and shoulders.

reaction.name: Bringer of Famine
entries: Field hags haunt farmlands and wild patches in grasslands and plains that support nomads and locals. It is hungry bellies that nourish the hags, and appropriately, they are attended by various destructive insects, such as locusts. The hags prefer to devastate crops and patches of wild plants to watch the entire local food chain collapse and to feast on the resulting hunger, or they might take a slower approach, relying on insect-borne blights to slowly wither the plants. They might later use their magic to enhance plant growth during famine to keep the starving alive—but still hungry.

reaction.name: Harmless Shapes
entries: As famine sets in, field hags take on the appearance of gentle animals, such as deer and rabbits, allowing them to draw closer to their prey. Canny observers notice the multitude of insects surrounding these animals.

trait.name: Arcane Scales
entries: While the spellscale vassal is conscious, wearing no armor, and wielding no shield, it adds its CHA modifier to its AC (included above).

trait.name: Draconic Bond
entries: The spellscale vassal is magically bound to a specific type of dragon. It is immune to one type of damage associated with that dragon: acid (black or copper), cold (silver or white), fire (brass, gold, or red), lightning (blue or bronze), poison (green), necrotic (void), or radiant (yellow).

trait.name: Draconic Weapons
entries: The spellscale vassal’s weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d6 damage of the type chosen with Draconic Bond.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spellscale vassal makes two Greatsword attacks, or it makes three Draconic Orb attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) damage of the type chosen with Draconic Bond.

action.name: Draconic Orb
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) damage of the type chosen with Draconic Bond.

action.name: Draconic Breath (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The spellscale vassal exhales an elemental blast in a 45-foot cone or a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide (the vassal’s choice). Each creature in that cone or line must make a DC 16 DEX save, taking 31 (9d6) damage of the type chosen with Draconic Bond on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Brutal Backhand
entries: The spellscale vassal backhands a creature within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 DEX save or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the vassal or knocked prone (the vassal’s choice). 275 S S Spider, Lustralichen Glowing webs stretch between the trees, sparkling in the fading light. A large spider descends, iridescent bumps shimmering across its carapace.

bonus.name: Symbiotic Arachnid
entries: Long ago, a giant spider built an egg sac in a patch of bioluminescent fungus, and the hatching spiderlings carried its hallucinogenic spores on their bodies. The spiders proved immune to the spores’ effects but also more successful than their uninfected peers, so the fungus flourished on its new mobile home. Since then, lustralichen spiders have developed a symbiotic relationship with the fungus: the spider devours prey in the throes of hallucinations, and the fungus gorges on the emotions of the victims.

bonus.name: Mind-Altering Webs
entries: A lustralichen spider’s webbing is coated in the fungus’s spores, and those caught in it are subject to its hallucinogenic effects. When they are finally confronted by the spider, victims see multiple spiders on top of each other, uncertain of which is real and which is hallucination.

trait.name: Magic-Infused Webs
entries: A creature restrained by a web made by the spellweaver has disadvantage on saves against the spellweaver’s attacks and spells.

trait.name: Monstrosity Resilience
entries: The spellweaver is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spellweaver can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
entries: While in contact with a web, the spellweaver knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spellweaver ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spellweaver makes one Bite attack and one Webbed Staff attack, or it makes two Poison Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Webbed Staff
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) force damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be restrained by magical webs for 1 minute. When a creature starts its turn restrained by this effect, it takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. A creature, including the restrained target, can take its action to free the target by succeeding on a DC 13 STR check.

action.name: Poison Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) force damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.

action.name: Spellcasting
entries: The spellweaver casts one of the following spells, using CHA as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14). At will: command , detect magic , mage hand , prestidigitation 2/day each: hold , ray of enfeeblement , web 1/day each: fear , slow

bonus.name: Web Step
entries: The spellweaver magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space. The origin and destination spaces must be in an area with webbing.

bonus.name: Web (Recharge 4–6)
entries: The spellweaver launches a gob of webbing at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 13 DEX save or be restrained. A creature, including the restrained target, can take its action to free the target from the webbing by succeeding on a DC 13 STR check. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage). 127 E E

monster.name: Starspot Swarm
languages: understands Auran and Ignan but can’t speak

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The starspot swarm doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Elemental Swarm Resilience
entries: The starspot swarm is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. In addition, it is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: Energy Bleed (145 HP or Fewer)
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm’s space must succeed on a DC 19 DEX save or take 7 (2d6) fire damage and 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

trait.name: Final Pulse
entries: When the starspot swarm dies, it explodes. Each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 19 DEX save, taking 21 (6d6) fire damage and 18 (4d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny Elemental. The swarm can’t regain HP or gain temporary HP.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The starspot swarm makes two Slams attacks.

action.name: Slams
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm’s space. Hit: 28 (8d6) fire damage plus 27 (6d8) lightning damage, or 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage if the swarm has half of its HP or fewer.

action.name: Gravitational Flux (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The starspot swarm’s light and dark motes spin in opposite directions, disrupting nearby gravity. Each creature within 20 feet of the swarm must make a DC 19 STR save. On a failure, a creature takes 65 (10d12) force damage and has the gravity affecting it increased (50 percent chance) or decreased (50 percent chance) for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, and the gravity around it is unaffected. A creature with increased gravity has its speed halved, and it can’t take bonus actions or reactions. A creature with decreased gravity floats vertically 20 feet and remains suspended there for the duration, as if affected by the levitate spell, and it falls at the end of the duration, taking falling damage if it lands on a solid surface. An affected creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. 277 S S

monster.name: Steam Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator

trait.name: Boiler Weakness
entries: If a creature scores a critical hit with an effect that deals cold damage, or if the golem fails a save by 5 or more against a spell that deals cold damage, it loses steam pressure. Without steam pressure, the golem can’t use the Puff of Steam or Steam Blast actions, and its speed is halved. On its turn, it can take a bonus action and make a DC 19 CON save, starting its boiler on a success.

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The golem doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Golem Resilience
entries: The golem is immune to poison and psychic damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to exhaustion and to the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions. G G 164 Heated Weapons. The steam golem’s weapon attacks are magical. When the golem hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d8 fire damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two Axe Arm attacks and one Long Axe attack, or it makes three Puff of Steam attacks.

action.name: Axe Arm
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

action.name: Long Axe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

action.name: Puff of Steam
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

action.name: Steam Blast (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The steam golem releases a blast of steam in a 60-foot cone or in a 20-foot radius around it. Each creature in the area must make a DC 17 DEX save, taking 49 (11d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Whistle
entries: When a creature the steam golem can see within 30 feet of it casts a spell, the steam golem emits a shriek from its twin steam whistles. The target must succeed on a DC 17 CON save or the spell fails to cast, expending the action required to cast it but not the spell slot or daily use. Golem, Wax The woman in the hallway stands perfectly still, as if frozen. She turns suddenly, her movements slow and stilted, and the light catches the waxy sheen of her skin while accentuating the lifelessness in her eyes.

reaction.name: Malleable Minions
entries: Wax golems are some of the easiest golems to construct, given the availability of wax and how workable it is, but they are also some of the least stable, susceptible to heat and open flames. Still, they remain a more easily attainable alternative to a clay golem, and the malleability of wax means they can be crafted to closely resemble people, assuming its crafter has the appropriate level of craftsmanship.

reaction.name: Simulacra
entries: While wax can sometimes flow, melt, or droop, by embedding part of a specific humanoid’s body within the wax golem, such as bone, hair, or even blood, the golem can emulate the likeness of that specific person so closely and consistently that it can be mistaken for them if standing still. Unfortunately, its odd gait and the jerkiness of its movements often give away its true nature once it moves.

reaction.name: Creator Connection
entries: A wax golem, even one who has assumed the likeness of an individual, contains something dear to its creator. This is usually something significant that the creator associates with candlelight, such as the page from a book they read, an eating implement from a candlelit meal, or a scrap of fabric from a sleeping robe.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: The elemental doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Elemental Resilience
entries: The elemental is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the stenar is motionless and prone alongside at least two other stenar, it is indistinguishable from a normal rocky outcropping, hill, or similar terrain feature.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The stenar has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one other stenar is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stenar makes two Smash or Throw Stone attacks.

action.name: Smash
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage. S S 278 Throw Stone. Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Throw Stenar
entries: The stenar throws another stenar within 5 feet of it at a point or creature the stenar can see within 60 feet of it. If the target is a creature, the creature must make a DC 12 STR save. The target has disadvantage on this save if a stenar is within 5 feet of it. On a failure, the target takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, it takes half the damage and isn’t knocked prone. The thrown stenar then lands prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that point or target and takes no damage from being thrown or impacting another creature.

bonus.name: Sliding Surface
entries: The stenar causes the earth beneath a creature it can see within 10 feet of itself to move. The target must succeed on a DC 12 DEX save or be pushed up to 10 feet in a direction of the stenar’s choice. Each friendly stenar within 10 feet of this stenar can use a reaction to enhance this effect, increasing the DC by 1 and pushing the target an additional 5 feet for each stenar participating, to a maximum of four additional stenar.

reaction.name: Rock Step
entries: When a friendly stenar this stenar can see within 30 feet of it is pushed, pulled, thrown, or otherwise moved outside its normal movement, this stenar can teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that friendly stenar.

trait.name: Cloak of Souls
entries: A creature that can sense Undead can sense the stitchcloak via the cloak of souls it wears.

trait.name: Transferring Tether
entries: While it is tethered to a creature, the stitchcloak takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and the tethered creature takes the other half.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stitchcloak makes three Soul Scissors attacks or four Rend Spirit attacks. It can replace one attack with Release Soul. If two Soul Scissors attacks hit one creature that is mortal and has a soul, the target’s soul is stitched to the fiend’s cloak via a spectral tether until the stitchcloak chooses to stitch another creature’s soul or until either creature dies. The stitchcloak absorbs the soul of any creature that dies while tethered, and that creature can’t be restored to life while the stitchcloak lives.

action.name: Soul Scissors
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or its HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its HP maximum to 0.

action.name: Rend Spirit
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) necrotic damage, and the target can’t regain HP until the start of the stitchcloak’s next turn.

action.name: Release Soul
entries: The stitchcloak pulls souls from its cloak, which manifest as 1d4 shadows or 1 specter in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the stitchcloak. The Undead act as allies of the stitchcloak and obey its spoken commands. The Undead remain for 1 hour, until the stitchcloak dies, or until the stitchcloak dismisses them as a bonus action. The stitchcloak can have any number of Undead under its control at one time, provided the combined total CR of the Undead is no higher than 2.

bonus.name: Screaming Soul
entries: The souls in the stitchcloak’s cloak shriek and moan. Each creature within 15 feet of the stitchcloak must succeed on a DC 16 WIS save or be frightened until the end of its next turn. Creatures that are deafened are immune to this effect. 279 S S

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The stone sage can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the sage doesn’t disturb the material through which it moves.

trait.name: One with the Earth
entries: When standing on stone or earth, the stone sage has advantage on ability checks and saves against being knocked prone or moved against its will.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The stone sage deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The stone sage’s Stealth is 14 while in rocky terrain. S S 280 Stone Walk. Difficult terrain composed of earth or stone doesn’t cost the stone sage extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stone sage makes three Slam attacks, or it makes two Conjured Boulder attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Conjured Boulder
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Stone Slide
entries: The stone sage calls a rockslide in a 15-foot line that is 5 feet wide, originating from a point on the ground the stone sage can see within 30 feet of it. Each creature in that line must succeed on a DC 14 DEX save or be knocked prone.

bonus.name: Stone to Mud
entries: The stone sage causes the ground within 10 feet of a point the sage can see within 30 feet of it to soften and stick to the feet of nearby creatures. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or have its speed halved until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is restrained until the end of its next turn instead.

monster.name: Stone Sifter
languages: understands Deep Speech but can’t speak

trait.name: Aberrant Resilience
entries: The stone sifter is resistant to the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, and stunned conditions, and it has advantage on saves against spells or effects that would alter its form.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The stone sifter can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the sifter doesn’t disturb the material through which it moves.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stone sifter makes one Slam attack and four Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.

action.name: Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 17 STR save or be knocked prone.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The sifter can have up to four creatures grappled at a time.

action.name: Stone Shower (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The stone sifter forcefully releases stones from its mouth or gills. If releasing from its mouth, it spits stone in a 30-foot cone. If releasing from its gills, stone flies out at every creature within 15 feet of it. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 DEX save, taking 40 (9d8) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Sift
entries: The stone sifter burrows up to its burrowing speed, refilling with stone. It can immediately try to recharge its Stone Shower action. 281 S S

trait.name: Squat Body
entries: The stonefish drake has advantage on saves against being pushed or knocked prone.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The stonefish drake’s Stealth is 15 while in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Warrens Builder
entries: If the drake burrows at half its burrowing speed, it can leave a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stonefish drake makes one Bite attack and two Tail Slam attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 STR save or be knocked prone.

action.name: Sandblasting Breath (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The drake exhales scorching sand in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 DEX save, taking 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Breaching Lunge
entries: The stonefish drake burrows up to 15 feet, emerging from the ground and landing on the surface. It occupies a space of its choice within 5 feet of where it emerges, and each creature within 10 feet of that point must succeed on a DC 16 DEX save or be knocked prone in the drake’s space. Any creature that succeeds is pushed into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the drake. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the drake’s space. As the drake lands, its folded back sail bursts open, releasing a cloud of dust and sand in a 10-foot radius around the drake that lasts until the end of the drake’s next turn. A creature that enters the cloud for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its turn, as the cloud chokes it, disrupts its vision, or similarly hinders it.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of lightning. Each creature within 5 feet of the mephit must succeed on a DC 11 DEX save or have disadvantage on weapon attack rolls and ability checks that use STR for 1 minute.

trait.name: Elemental Nature
entries: As the glass mephit.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the mephit remains motionless and hovering, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary storm cloud.

action.name: Claws
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

action.name: Thunder Orb
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) thunder damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 STR save or be pushed up to 5 feet away from the mephit.

action.name: Tempest Breath (Recharge 6)
entries: The mephit exhales a breath of swirling wind, lightning, and thunder in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 CON save. On a failure, a creature takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage and is deafened until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t deafened.

bonus.name: Storm Burst (1/Day)
entries: The mephit casts the thunderwave spell (spell save DC 11), using CHA as the spellcasting ability. 205 M M

trait.name: Lightning Hide
entries: A creature that touches the storm serpent or hits it with a melee attack while within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 DEX save or take 4 (1d8) lightning damage.

trait.name: Monstrosity Resilience
entries: The storm serpent is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

trait.name: Storm Rider
entries: The storm serpent can fly in high winds, precipitation, and stormy weather without needing to make an ability check, and moving through such weather doesn’t cost it extra movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The storm serpent makes one Bite and one Whiptail attack, or it makes two Thunderbolt attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

action.name: Whiptail
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

action.name: Thunderbolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) thunder damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.

action.name: Leaping Lightning (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The storm serpent sends a bolt of lightning toward a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The bolt then leaps to up to two other creatures within 30 feet of that target. Each target must make a DC 15 DEX save, taking 31 (7d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Along for the Ride
entries: The storm serpent can turn up to three willing creatures it can see within 15 feet of it into wisps of cloud. This effect works like the wind walk spell, except it lasts only 1 minute, and an affected creature must remain within 100 feet of the storm serpent or the effect immediately ends for it.

trait.name: Death Aura
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of a styx demon automatically fail death saves.

trait.name: Demonic Resilience
entries: The styx demon is resistant to cold and lightning damage. In addition, it is immune to poison damage and to the poisoned condition.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The styx demon has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The styx demon makes three Freezing Claw or Death Bolt attacks. If two Freezing Claw attacks hit one creature, the target is restrained until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Freezing Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.

action.name: Death Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) necrotic damage. The demon has advantage on this attack if the target is below half its HP maximum.

action.name: Spellcasting
entries: The styx demon can cast the disguise self and levitate spells at will, requiring no material components and using CHA as the spellcasting ability.

bonus.name: River Hunter
entries: The styx demon moves up to half its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see. If the target is in water, the styx demon has advantage on the next attack roll it makes against the target before the start of its next turn.

reaction.name: Soul Eater
entries: When a creature the styx demon can see within 30 feet of it is reduced to 0 HP, the styx demon can devour a portion of its soul, gaining 9 (2d8) temporary HP and forcing the target to immediately make a death save. 93 D D Devil, Arch-Devil, Abizeth

reaction.name: The giant has long, jet-black hair, wild and wind tossed
entries: His eyes burn with fire, as does the massive two-handed sword he carries. Long, curling horns protrude from his brow, and feathered wings sprout from his shoulders—one broken and partially stripped of its black feathers.

reaction.name: Fallen Angel
entries: Abizeth, the Burning Brand and Lord of Vengeance, rules over a wasteland of Hell where warlords and their followers fight in endless blood feuds so ancient that their reasons are long forgotten. But the burning hatred remains. Once the angelic warlord of a deity of justice, Abizeth disobeyed his lady, refusing to yield the field after she proclaimed mercy for an enemy. He and those celestials that followed him into battle against her direct command were then cast out, sent hurtling into the Hells. Abizeth’s wing was broken in the fall and won’t heal. Religious scholars theorize that it will be restored only when he humbles himself and admits his wrongdoing.

reaction.name: Stoking the Fires
entries: Abizeth is the Lord of Vengeance and Grievances, and he compels mortals to tap into their anger and seek immediate and violent redress of perceived wrongs. He speaks with fire and passion, but his delivery is deliberate and calculated. He especially delights in twisting otherwise just reprisals into bloody revenge, reveling in the evils wrought by ill-timing and excess.

reaction.name: Vengeance Delivered
entries: Abizeth’s ear is keenly tuned to the mortal world. He needs more vengeful souls to swell the ranks of his armies in order to one day march upon the heavens and seek redress against his mistress for casting him out. Pleas offered to the darkness, seeking vengeance for perceived wrongs, fall on Abizeth’s ears more often than not. Those he deems worthy are contacted—typically through one of his servitors—and offered counsel and aid for the price of both their loyalty and their soul.

reaction.name: Loyal Servitors
entries: Servitors of Abizeth are devils created specifically by and to serve Abizeth and act as his intermediaries when dealing with mortals. These devils exploit any weaknesses of personality a mortal might possess, playing on vanity, insecurity, or hot-headedness, and manipulate the mortal into exacting bloody vengeance, forever marking their soul for Abizeth. Despite the servitors’ monstrous appearance, they radiate an aura of nobility, saving their menace instead for the enemies of those entreating for their master’s aid. ABIZETH’S LAIR Abizeth’s fortress lies at the center of a war-torn and ravaged land. Great war engines stand on wide walls behind battlements more than a dozen times taller than a human. Bearded devils man the walls and gates, led by Abizeth’s servitor devils. At its heart, Abizeth sits upon a D D 94 morbid throne made from the bones of fallen enemies. Here, he plots, listening to the angry howls of souls consumed by vengeance, both outside the castle and in the mortal realm. When encountered in his lair, Abizeth has a challenge rating of 22. LAIR ACTIONS On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Abizeth can take a lair action to cause one of the following effects; Abizeth can’t use the same effect two rounds in a row: • Fog of War. Magical fog fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point Abizeth can see within 120 feet of him. The fog spreads around corners and its area is lightly obscured. Those within the fog have their anger heightened by the fog’s magical effects. A creature that isn’t a Fiend or Undead and that starts its turn in the fog must succeed on a DC 21 WIS save or immediately use its reaction to make one melee attack against a random creature within 5 feet of it, as it is temporarily overcome with rage. The fog lasts for 1 minute, until Abizeth uses this lair action again, or until Abizeth dies. • Gout of Flame. A blast of flame erupts from a point on a surface Abizeth can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature in a 30-foot cone from that point must make a DC 21 DEX save. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) fire damage and catches fire; until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. On a success, the target takes half the damage and doesn’t catch fire. • River of Blood. Blood flows in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide and 1 inch deep across the ground, starting from a point Abizeth can see within 120 feet of him. The river’s area is difficult terrain, and any creature that enters or moves through the area must succeed on a DC 21 DEX save or fall prone at the end of its movement. The DC increases by 1 for every 5 feet the creature moves through the river beyond the first 5 feet. The river lasts for 1 minute, until Abizeth uses this lair action again, or until Abizeth dies. REGIONAL EFFECTS The region surrounding Abizeth’s lair is warped by his magic, which creates one or more of the following effects: • Crowing Death. Hellish crows infest the land within 5 miles of the lair, clustering on trees and picking over any dead they find. They regularly circle overhead, croaking and harassing travelers, and their constant presence makes traveling without being noticed more difficult. • Stoked Fires. Humanoids near the lair become bold and brash, but they are more susceptible to tales of treachery and betrayal. A creature has disadvantage on CHA (Intimidation) checks against a Humanoid that has spent at least 24 hours within 10 miles of the lair. In addition, a creature has advantage on CHA (Persuasion) checks to convince such a Humanoid they have been betrayed or wronged. • Whispering Fog. Genie, Forsaken The desiccated humanoid reaches out blackened, taloned hands while floating within a horrific, roiling miasma. Screaming, deathly faces peer out from the dark mist.

action.name: Fallen Genie
entries: Though most genies dissipate into a breeze upon their death, some find their souls bound instead to the mortal realm by foul necromancy, broken oaths, or the whims of the divine. Tormented by life and by the guilt of their own transgressions, the undead genies become raging, bestial versions of their once noble forms.

action.name: Hungering Absolution
entries: Forsaken genies hunt the world for their absolution. Many are attracted to sources of magic, hopeful that if they can find or destroy the right relic, they might be forgiven or even regain their former states. Still others want nothing more than to destroy all the light in the world—a mirror to their howling despair.

action.name: Boilers and Hydraulics
entries: A steam golem is built around a central boiler, and clockwork gears and hydraulics power its limbs. Most such golems have axe blades welded onto each of their arms, one longer than the other, and their legs are often built with reversed knee joints for improved leverage while supporting their towering form. Their eyes have a reddish glow from the fires burning within.

Planar Flora A toothy maw made of leaves scuttles forward like a spider on root-legs, and an angelic root creature with leaf-like wings descends. Puffs of orange and violet flowers swirl as a scintillating, jellyfish-like vine floats by them. Nearby, a lumpy clay person covered in fuzzy moss puts an arm around a soaking- wet moss person with piscine eyes.

bonus.name: Planar Plants
entries: Just as each plane has its own strange but mundane animals, each also has strange but mundane plants. These plants are known as planar flora. Each has adaptations for surviving in its unique environment, from pulling nutrients out of the burning soil of the Plane of Fire to subsisting on memories lost throughout the planes.

bonus.name: Flowers of the Hells
entries: Fiendish viletraps are carnivorous plants with toothy maws, and they range across the blasted landscapes and battlefields of the Lower Planes. Battalions of them travel alongside fiendish armies, acting in the thousands as shock troops at the start and waste disposal at the end of any conflict.

bonus.name: Ethereal Predators
entries: Ghostweeds are pale, shimmering plant creatures that thrive in the Ethereal Plane. There, they float through the foggy landscape, sensing for prey in the Material Plane and then pouncing across the planes to feast. Creatures slain after exposure to the ghostweed’s otherworldly pollen return as specters (see Monster Vault ), though the two seem to have no other clear relationship. Many necromancers have tried to harness the plant’s pollen to create more powerful undead but without success.

bonus.name: Clusters of Forgetting
entries: Lethblooms are rot-smelling flowers that sprout by the spirit-sapping rivers of the Plane of Shadow. A single blossom poses little danger, supping on the faint memories that drift on the winds and waters, but large patches of the flowers can quickly overtake unwary travelers. Creatures surrounded by them find themselves assaulted with bursting puffs of purple and orange petals, causing them to slowly forget how to defend themselves.

bonus.name: Celestial Forest Wardens
entries: Liliums are root-like creatures that grow in the ordered forests of the Upper Planes. Through its centuries-long growth to adulthood, a lilium is taught to defend the celestial realms and the natural wilds of the Material Plane. Staunch guardians, they take to their tasks with a fervor, defending their charges from any perceived dangers. A lilium’s upbringing leads it to have a very ordered and hierarchical view of the world with celestials at the top. This occasionally results in liliums following the orders of mischievous or unscrupulous celestials, even against their better judgment.

bonus.name: Elemental Moss
entries: Planeworts are moss creatures shaped like small humanoids. Native to the elemental planes, they can quickly adapt their bodies to whichever plane they happen to find themselves on. Staid, hard-working, friendly, and communal, they have been part of the elemental planes for as long as the planes have existed, tending to each plane’s unique, natural environs. They regularly traverse from one plane to another in nomadic groups, and their ire is raised when these travels are disrupted. They otherwise ignore any feuding, politicking, or similar goings-on among the genies and other elementals, and they are typically left to themselves. Most elementals disregard them, though often respecting their important but mundane role.

bonus.name: Twisted Treants
entries: Weeping treants clearly are related to other treants, but they are smaller than the normal variety. Their gnarled trunks are twisted, and their wood often groans when they move.

bonus.name: Forest Wardens
entries: Weeping treants are protectors of dark, shadowy forests—particularly forests in the Plane of Shadow—and they are as long-lived as the trees themselves. They act as guardians for an entire forest or for something specific within the forest, and they have no pity for those carrying axes or fire.

bonus.name: Skeptical Mein
entries: Weeping treants are terrifying and relentless when fighting in defense of their charge. They are inherently distrustful, particularly of anything not of the natural or shadow world, and they’re notoriously difficult to fool or deceive.

bonus.name: Enchanted Bitter Tears

bonus.name: Void-Tainted
entries: Void trolls are trolls whose adaptive and regenerative nature becomes warped by sustained exposure to the Void and its energies. Every time a void troll regenerates, it is infused with more void energy. As the energy grows, so does the feeling of emptiness inside the troll, a hunger it can never truly sate.

bonus.name: Opposing Drives
entries: A void troll’s hunger keeps its rooted to the world of living prey, but the Void also calls to it, a fundamental longing that increases over time. Many void trolls feel trapped by these warring impulses, which steadily strain the trolls’ minds.

bonus.name: Hollow Hunger
entries: Stories persist among void trolls that a cult called the Hollow Hunger have learned to control their rampant hunger, gaining clarity of mind and purpose. However, none have ever seen actual members of the cult, and many believe the Hollow Hunger is just a story told to give void trolls some measure of hope.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The truescale has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the truescale’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

trait.name: Shoulder Charge
entries: If the truescale moves at least 15 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the truescale has disadvantage on attack rolls, and its Perception is 7 when perceiving by sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The truescale makes two Slam attacks. If both Slam attacks hit one creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 13). The truescale can grapple only one target at a time.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Crush
entries: One creature grappled by the truescale must succeed a DC 13 STR save or take 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage and begin suffocating. The creature continues suffocating until the grapple ends.

monster.name: Tunnel Rumbler
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can’t

trait.name: Construct Nature
entries: The tunnel rumbler doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Construct Resilience
entries: The tunnel rumbler is immune to poison and psychic damage, and it is immune to exhaustion and the charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.

trait.name: Folding Configuration
entries: The tunnel rumbler’s body is made of folding, telescoping, and collapsible parts, allowing it to easily move through any opening large enough for a Large creature. It can squeeze through any opening large enough for a Medium creature. The rumbler’s destination must still have suitable room to accommodate its volume. T T 294

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tunnel rumbler makes one Clamping Claw or Spinning Brush attack and two Weapon Arm attacks.

action.name: Clamping Claw
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the rumbler can’t use Clamping Claw on another target.

action.name: Spinning Brush
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 CON save or suffer a bleeding wound. A creature with a bleeding wound loses 4 (1d8) HP at the start of each of its turns. Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 12 WIS (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

action.name: Weapon Arm
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, depending on the type of weapon installed.

bonus.name: Throw
entries: One Large or smaller creature grappled by the tunnel rumbler is thrown up to 30 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 DEX save or take the same damage and be knocked prone. Undead Lords The gleam in the glassy eyes of the undead noble in faded finery burns with necrotic power.

bonus.name: Deathless Leaders
entries: Undead lords are far more intelligent than their lesser counterparts, and they retain their personalities and memories. With the ability to think, plan, and strategize, they command legions of other undead. Most undead lords rise from influential leaders, typically nobles, generals, guild masters, or merchant lords.

bonus.name: Lord of Hordes
entries: A figure of strong will who dies in a place infused with necromantic energy can draw the corruption into itself and rise as a zombie lord. This corruption seeps out of the lord in a subtle, constant wave of necrosis, causing even long-dead corpses to quicken and rise in answer. Its mind twisted with jealousy and obsession for what it left behind, it uses those it commands to accomplish all it missed out on in life.

bonus.name: Risen Celebrity
entries: A ghoul lord usually forms when a beloved noble or monarch falls to the ghoul hunger disease (see Monster Vault ). Its personality and sway over people are so potent that when it rises, its fallen courtiers and servants rise with it as lesser undead. In some cases, a desperate monarch close to losing power might give itself over to the disease to rise again with an unstoppable legion of hungry undead, securing its long-term power.

bonus.name: Masterful Tactician
entries: Necromantic energy seeps out from a skeleton lord, coating its blade and imbuing the weapon with the power to slice through a creature’s lifeforce. These undead lords are masterful tacticians and often serve as generals for liches or powerful necromancers.

trait.name: Fey Resilience
entries: Tynan is resistant to the charmed and unconscious conditions.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Tynan fails a save, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Tynan has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Red Sun Orb
entries: Tynan can use her orb to cast the scrying spell. If the target is within 5 miles of her lair, the save DC is modified as if she has firsthand knowledge of the creature and is in possession of one of its body parts.

trait.name: Speak with Animals
entries: Tynan can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Weapons of Light and Shadow
entries: Tynan’s weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 5d6 cold damage or radiant damage (included in the attack), Tynan’s choice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tynan makes three Cervid Scepter or Twilight Bolt attacks. If two Cervid Scepter or Twilight Bolt attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 17 CON save or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Cervid Scepter
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (5d6) cold damage or radiant damage (Tynan’s choice).

action.name: Twilight Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) cold damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 CHA save or have disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check.

bonus.name: Rising Sun, Setting Sun
entries: Tynan fills one friendly creature she can see within 30 feet of her with the hope of new beginnings, and she fills one hostile creature she can see within 30 feet of her with the despair of endings. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a DC 17 WIS save is unaffected. The next time either target makes an attack roll or save before the start of Tynan’s next turn, it must roll a d8. The friendly creature adds the number rolled to the attack roll or save, while the hostile creature subtracts it.

bonus.name: Twilight Step
entries: Tynan teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see. The origin and destination spaces must be in dim light.

reaction.name: Vexing Shadows
entries: When a creature Tynan can see targets her with an attack, she can interpose a shadow between herself and the attack. The attacker must succeed on a DC 17 WIS save or miss the attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Tynan moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Shifting Shadows
entries: Tynan changes the brightness of one source of light or darkness within 60 feet of her, such as a torch, from bright to dim, dim to dark, or dark to dim.

legendary.name: Bright Dawn, Lonely Night (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tynan sends the twin powers of light and dark at two creatures she can see within 60 feet of her. One target must succeed on a DC 17 CON save or be blinded until the end of its next turn, and the other target must succeed on a DC 17 WIS save or be frightened until the end of its next turn. 135 F F Fey Lord, Forgotten Smith In a cavern lit by the glow of a burning hearth stands a tall, broad-shouldered man with long, dark hair, lavender eyes, and pointed ears. He stands over an anvil, wearing a leather apron with sleeves rolled up to reveal strong, tattooed arms. A hammer is clutched in one hand.

legendary.name: Erased from History
entries: The Forgotten Smith is a fey lord whose mastery of crafting was unrivaled in the faerie realms. Long ago, he was a paramour of the Queen of Night and Magic, and she commissioned him to craft potent weapons to help secure her power. The smith pooled all his arts to make these weapons, crafting items never before seen among the fey. The queen, upon receiving these weapons, knew she could never let them, or the knowledge used to create them, fall into others’ hands. So, because of the love she once had for the smith, instead of killing him, she erased his memory and struck his name from all fey history. The Forgotten Smith now wanders the borders of F F 136 the faerie realms, establishing forges in dark and hidden places. He seeks to recreate the masterpieces that dance at the edges of his memory, always just out of reach, but is continually frustrated in his attempts.

legendary.name: Master Craftsman
entries: The Forgotten Smith often agrees to craft complex and powerful items for those who take the time to seek him out. Such requests give him the opportunity to stretch his skills, in the hopes they might restore some of his lost knowledge. But before crafting anything, he insists on carefully worded and detailed contracts with the petitioners. These contracts often require the petitioners to obtain the raw materials, and they always include a clause that protects the smith’s knowledge of the item.

legendary.name: Vengeful and Quick to Anger
entries: While the Forgotten Smith generally conveys a taciturn and unemotional facade, he is quick to anger when a contract is broken. He will go so far as to hunt down such individuals to administer faerie justice—usually violently. THE FORGOTTEN SMITH’S LAIR The Forgotten Smith establishes lairs in remote, enclosed locations in the faerie realms that can withstand the heat of his forge, such as large caverns, mountain peaks, or ancient ruins. The central feature of these lairs is always the Smith’s forge, which is meticulously set up and arranged. When encountered in his lair, the Forgotten Smith has a challenge rating of 19. LAIR ACTIONS On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the Forgotten Smith can take a lair action to cause one of the following effects; the Forgotten Smith can’t use the same effect two rounds in a row: • Equipment Instability. The forge’s magic destabilizes worn or wielded items within 20 feet of a point the

legendary.name: Forgotten Smith can see within 60 feet of him
entries: An attack roll made in that area with a manufactured weapon, such as a sword or bow, is made with disadvantage, and the AC provided by manufactured, metal armor in the area is reduced by 2. Weapons and armor wielded and worn by the Forgotten Smith are unaffected. These effects last until initiative count 20 on the next round. • Fiery Hearth. The heat of the forge surges from a point the Forgotten Smith can see within 60 feet of him. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 18 DEX save, taking 13 (3d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. • Thundering Cacophony. The sound of hammering metal rings and clangs around one point the Forgotten

legendary.name: Smith can see within 60 feet of him
entries: Each creature within 20 feet of that point must make a DC 18 CON save. On a failure, a creature takes 10 (3d6) thunder damage and is deafened until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t deafened. REGIONAL EFFECTS The region containing the Forgotten Smith’s lair is altered by his magic, which creates one or more of the following effects: • Enhanced Creation. An item crafted within 10 miles of the Forgotten Smith’s lair is an exceptional version of that item, regardless of the skill level of its creator, increasing the item’s hit points by 2d4 and damage threshold by 2. • Memory Lapses. Creatures within 3 miles of the Forgotten Smith’s lair are stricken by gaps in their memories, a byproduct of the Smith’s curse. These lapses last for 1d12 hours or until the creature finishes a long rest outside the area. • Structural Integrity. Each object and structure within 1 mile of the Forgotten Smith’s lair increases its hit points by 2d6. If the Forgotten Smith dies, these effects fade in 1d10 days.

trait.name: Giant Attributes
entries: The umbral ogre is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.

trait.name: Shadow Weapons
entries: The umbral ogre’s weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d4 cold damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the umbral ogre has disadvantage on attack rolls, and its Perception is 8 when perceiving by sight. O O 226

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The umbral ogre makes two Greataxe attacks, or it makes three Shadow Bolt attacks.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) cold damage.

action.name: Shadow Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (5d4 + 3) cold damage.

bonus.name: Extract Memory
entries: The umbral ogre extracts a random memory from one creature with an INT of −3 or higher it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 WIS save or be stunned for 1 minute, as its memory becomes a wisp of silver filament curling out of its head. The ogre then gains 7 (2d6) temporary HP. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success and regaining the memory. If the target fails this save three times, it permanently loses the memory, which floats to the ogre, and the ogre regains 14 (4d6) HP. A creature that permanently lost a memory can have it restored only through the greater restoration spell or similar magic.

bonus.name: Shadow Step
entries: The umbral ogre teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The origin and destination must be in dim light or darkness. Ooze, Eldritch

bonus.name: The blob swirls with colors and arcane energy
entries: A pseudopod covered in flames one moment instead crackles with lightning the next.

bonus.name: Failed Experiment
entries: The eldritch ooze is the result of attempts by a cabal of spellcasters to enhance black puddings, evolving them into intelligent guardians capable of defending against attacks by magical rivals. No longer the deep black of their ancestors, the eldritch ooze is translucent and shot through with swirls of color. While less vulnerable to energy attacks, however, their intelligence still doesn’t match that of any cunning animal. They are commonly used simply as guardians, for their volatility often makes them unsuited for more specialized jobs.

bonus.name: Magic Eater
entries: Eldritch oozes can sense magic and will target enchanted items or magical creatures in preference to other prey, instinctively attacking those with the strongest auras. Devouring magic nourishes and rejuvenates the ooze.

monster.name: Unearthed
languages: understands the languages its corpses knew in

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The unearthed can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the unearthed doesn’t disturb the material through which it moves.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The unearthed doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Undead Resilience
entries: The unearthed is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition. U U 298

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The unearthed makes three Slam attacks or four Throw Dirt attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (5d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The unearthed can have up to six creatures grappled at a time.

action.name: Throw Dirt
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target’s speed is reduced by 10 feet until it or another creature uses an action to wipe off the dirt. The slowing effect of this attack is cumulative, reducing a target’s speed to no lower than 0.

action.name: Tearing Limbs (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The unearthed’s various limbs tear at up to three creatures grappled by the unearthed. Each target must make a DC 17 STR save, taking 55 (10d10) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If at least one creature failed the save, each creature within 30 feet of the unearthed must succeed on a DC 17 WIS save or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Entomb
entries: The unearthed deposits one creature it is grappling into a shallow hole in the ground, burying the creature and ending the grapple. A buried creature is restrained and unable to breathe or stand up. A creature, including the buried creature, can take its action to free the buried creature by succeeding on a DC 17 STR check.

trait.name: Dimming Presence
entries: Nonmagical sources of light provide only dim illumination while they are within 10 feet of the unflamed.

trait.name: Necrotic Weapons
entries: The unflamed’s weapon attacks are magical. When the unflamed hits with a melee weapon attack, the weapon deals an extra 1d6 necrotic damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Necrotic Wreath
entries: A creature that makes a death save while within 10 feet of the unflamed has disadvantage on the roll.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The unflamed doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Undead Resilience
entries: The unflamed is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The unflamed makes two Warhammer attacks.

action.name: Warhammer
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Necrotic Surge (Recharge 6)
entries: A surge of necrotic energy pulses out from the unflamed. Each creature within 10 feet of the unflamed must make a DC 13 CON save, taking 21 (6d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Absorb Soul
entries: When a creature dies within 10 feet of the unflamed, the unflamed can absorb the creature’s soul. Then, Necrotic Surge recharges, and the unflamed is empowered for 1 minute. While empowered, the unflamed’s speed is doubled, and it can use a bonus action on each of its turns to make one Warhammer attack or to take the Dash or Disengage action. If the unflamed is killed within 24 hours of absorbing the soul, the soul is set free and continues to the afterlife. A soul can’t be reclaimed once it has been in the unflamed’s possession for more than 24 hours, and nothing short of a wish spell or divine intervention can restore the creature’s soul. 299 U U Vampire Ants An enormous ant with jagged jaws stands guard over a pile of writhing larvae.

reaction.name: Wasteland Abductors
entries: Vampire ants are arthropods that stalk scrublands, canyons, and mountains. They attack at night, paralyzing creatures with deadly bites and dragging the victims back to their lairs.

reaction.name: Helpless Blood-Drinkers
entries: Vampire ant larvae are writhing, helpless grubs barely larger than a cat. The larvae drain the blood of living creatures, converting it into a nutritious substance.

reaction.name: Strange Feeding Habits
entries: Adult vampire ants can’t eat on their own; they can process only the substance produced after their larvae drink blood. To feed, they bring paralyzed or recently slain prey to feed their larvae, then feed upon the larvae in a harmless process.

reaction.name: Bloodsucker’s Pets
entries: Vampire ants are favored pets of vampires. The substance produced by the larvae is a delicacy known as “ant wine,” and many vampires keep pits of larvae. Some vampires are particularly proud of their ant wine vintages and breed the ants for their taste.

trait.name: Heightened Smell
entries: The ant’s perception is 18 when perceiving by smell.

trait.name: Monstrosity Resilience
entries: The ant is resistant to exhaustion and to the frightened condition.

action.name: Multiattack
