entries: The ystol squeezes a creature grappled by it, secreting acid on the creature. The target must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or take 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage and 4 (1d8) acid damage. 71 C C Chuul, Broodlings A swarm of tiny, tentacled crabs scuttles toward some small, random noise. The stench of brine fills the air.

bonus.name: Disposable Weapons
entries: At the height of their power, the ancient chuul empires would use ritual magic to create armies of broodlings. Thousands of crab eggs would be gathered and magically empowered, transforming the gestating creatures within into miniature, ravenous chuuls. The resulting swarm would then be deployed as a weapon, devouring any victims it could reach. Symbiotic Swarm. Broodlings form strong bonds with other aberrations. This results in the swarms constantly following these chosen creatures around and even exhibiting protective behavior— often even coating their host as a makeshift armor. The swarm will lash out at any aggressive action taken upon their host.

bonus.name: Favored Pets
entries: Individual broodlings that survive longer than a few weeks often become favored pets of their aberrant hosts or even of mortal cultists, perhaps receiving names or perches of honor or being draped in small decorations. Such connections might result in disproportionate retribution when said honored broodling falls in battle.

monster.name: Zombie Lord
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the zombie lord fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: The zombie lord and any friendly Undead within 30 feet of it have advantage on saves against effects that turn undead.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the zombie lord to 0 HP, it must make a CON save with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the lord drops to 1 HP instead.

trait.name: Undead Nature
entries: The zombie lord doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Undead Resilience
entries: The zombie lord is immune to poison damage, to exhaustion, and to the poisoned condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie lord makes two Slam or Rotten Bolt attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

action.name: Rotten Bolt
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) poison damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Undead Horde
entries: The zombie lord magically creates 2d4 skeletons or zombies in unoccupied spaces it can see within 30 feet of it. The Undead are allies that obey its spoken commands, and they remain until the lord dies or dismisses them as a bonus action. The zombie lord can have any number of skeletons and zombies under its control at one time, provided the combined total CR of the Undead is no higher than 4. 295 U U Rotten Horde (Recharge 5–6). The zombie lord causes putrid rot to burst out of up to three friendly Undead it can see within 30 feet of it. Each creature within 5 feet of a target must make a DC 15 CON save, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If bursts overlap each other, each creature in overlapping bursts must make only one save with disadvantage rather than one save for each burst.

bonus.name: Shambling Horde
entries: The zombie lord commands up to four skeletons and zombies within 30 feet of it to move. Each target can use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The zombie lord moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Bolster Horde (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each friendly skeleton and zombie within 15 feet of the zombie lord loses its vulnerability to bludgeoning damage and has advantage on CON saves triggered by its Undead Fortitude until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Call Horde (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The zombie lord uses Undead Horde.

trait.name: Giant Attributes
entries: The zwölfhulk is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.

trait.name: Show of Might
entries: The zwölfhulk can use STR instead of CHA when making CHA (Intimidation) checks.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The zwölfhulk deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The zwölfhulk’s long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zwölfhulk makes four Slam attacks or three Rock attacks. It can replace two Slam attacks with an Uprooted Sapling attack. If two Slam attacks hit one Large or smaller creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 16). It can have only one creature grappled at a time.

action.name: Slam
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Uprooted Sapling
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shockwave (Recharge 5–6)
entries: The zwölfhulk violently claps its four hands together, creating a thunderous shockwave in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 CON save. On a failure, a creature takes 31 (9d6) thunder damage and is deafened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t deafened. A creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus.name: Crush
entries: One creature grappled by the zwölfhulk must succeed on a DC 16 CON save or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and begin suffocating. The creature continues suffocating until the grapple ends. 321 Z Z APPENDIX: ANIMALS This appendix contains statistics for various beasts and vermin, many of which regularly find homes as beasts of burden or livestock to various Humanoids across the world or as loyal companions to adventurers.

bonus.name: Familiars
entries: At the GM’s discretion, some of the creatures in this appendix can be added to the list of animal forms available to a spellcaster via the create familiar or find familiar spells. Those creatures are: giant honey bee, opossum, and skunk. In addition, this book features other familiars that might have specific requirements, such as only serve spellcasters that craft items, or might require permission from a GM before choosing them as familiars. The Additional Familiars table lists where these familiars can be found in this book.
